1475def hand_mask(rec, overlays: dict | None = None) -> np.ndarray | None:
1476    """A tree's 256x256 hand mask: as drawn, or, given the line-up file's ``overlays``
1477    (:mod:`treeskel.annotate_mask`), moved onto the summer photo. With ``overlays``, a tree that was
1478    skipped or not lined up yet has none (None), so moved and unmoved masks are never mixed.
1479
1480    Args:
1481        rec: The tree's record.
1482        overlays: The line-ups per tree id; None for the mask as drawn.
1483
1484    Returns:
1485        The 256x256 boolean mask, or None (no mask, or not lined up).
1486    """
1487    from treeskel.io import load_mask
1488
1489    if not rec.has_mask:
1490        return None
1491    if overlays is None:
1492        return load_mask(rec.paths[("summer", "mask")])
1493    ov = overlays.get(rec.tree_id)
1494    if ov is None or ov.skip:
1495        return None
1496    from treeskel.annotate_mask import move_mask
1497
1498    return move_mask(load_mask(rec.paths[("summer", "mask")]), ov)
1499
1500
1501def load_frames(records: dict, ids: Sequence[str], size: int | tuple[int, int], depth: bool = False,
1502                progress: Callable[[str], None] = print,
1503                overlays: dict | None = None) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
1504    """The summer photos and hand masks of ``ids``: in the masks' frame (centre 480x480) at ``size`` x ``size``,
1505    or, for ``size = (height, width)``, the whole photo at that size with each mask on its centre columns
1506    (:func:`mask_to_photo`).
1507
1508    With ``overlays`` (the mask line-up file), each mask is moved onto its photo
1509    (:func:`hand_mask`), and trees not lined up count as having none.
1510
1511    Args:
1512        records: Tree records by id.
1513        ids: The trees to load.
1514        size: Square side (the masks' frame), or ``(height, width)`` (the whole photo).
1515        depth: Add the summer depth as a fourth channel.
1516        progress: Prints a progress line.
1517        overlays: The mask line-ups; None for the masks as drawn.
1518
1519    Returns:
1520        ``(images, masks, has_mask)``: ``(n, H, W, 3 or 4)`` uint8 (depth
1521        last, nearest-neighbour so no-reading zeros are not blended),
1522        ``(n, H, W)`` uint8 masks (0–255, bilinear, so soft at the edges;
1523        zero where there is none, and on a whole photo's side columns) and ``(n,)`` bool.
1524    """
1525    from PIL import Image
1526
1527    from treeskel.io import CROP_COLS, load_tree
1528
1529    whole = not isinstance(size, int)
1530    h, w = (int(size[0]), int(size[1])) if whole else (size, size)
1531    images = np.zeros((len(ids), h, w, 4 if depth else 3), np.uint8)
1532    masks = np.zeros((len(ids), h, w), np.uint8)
1533    has = np.zeros(len(ids), bool)
1534    step = max(1, len(ids) // 10)
1535    for i, t in enumerate(ids):
1536        summer = load_tree(records[t], "summer")
1537        crop = slice(0, None) if whole else slice(CROP_COLS[0], CROP_COLS[1])
1538        images[i, ..., :3] = np.asarray(Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(summer["rgb"][:, crop]))
1539                                        .resize((w, h), Image.BILINEAR))
1540        if depth:
1541            images[i, ..., 3] = np.asarray(Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(summer["depth"][:, crop]))
1542                                           .resize((w, h), Image.NEAREST))
1543        hm = hand_mask(records[t], overlays)
1544        if hm is not None:
1545            masks[i] = (mask_to_photo(hm, (h, w)) if whole else
1546                        np.asarray(Image.fromarray(hm.astype(np.uint8) * 255).resize((w, h), Image.BILINEAR)))
1547            has[i] = True
1548        if (i + 1) % step == 0 or i + 1 == len(ids):
1549            progress(f"  {i + 1}/{len(ids)} photos loaded")
1550    return images, masks, has
1551
1552
1553def save_masks(path: Path, ids: Sequence[str], masks: np.ndarray) -> None:
1554    """The predicted 256x256 masks of many trees, bit-packed, in one ``.npz``.
1555
1556    Args:
1557        path: The ``.npz`` file.
1558        ids: Tree ids, one per mask.
1559        masks: ``(n, 256, 256)`` boolean masks.
1560    """
1561    np.savez_compressed(path, ids=np.array(ids), bits=np.packbits(np.asarray(masks, bool), axis=-1),
1562                        shape=np.array(masks.shape[1:]))
1563
1564
1565def load_masks(path: Path) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
1566    """Inverse of :func:`save_masks`: ``{tree: (256, 256) bool}``.
1567
1568    Args:
1569        path: A file from :func:`save_masks`.
1570
1571    Returns:
1572        The masks per tree id.
1573    """
1574    with np.load(path) as z:
1575        w = int(z["shape"][1])
1576        bits = np.unpackbits(z["bits"], axis=-1)[..., :w].astype(bool)
1577        return {str(t): bits[i] for i, t in enumerate(z["ids"])}
1578
1579
1580def example_trees(dice: dict[str, float], k: int = 6) -> list[str]:
1581    """Trees at evenly spaced quantiles of the Dice score, worst to best, so the figure shows the range
1582    rather than the best cases.
1583
1584    Args:
1585        dice: Dice per tree id.
1586        k: Trees wanted.
1587
1588    Returns:
1589        Tree ids; empty if no tree has a finite score.
1590    """
1591    ranked = sorted((v, t) for t, v in dice.items() if np.isfinite(v))
1592    if not ranked:
1593        return []
1594    picks = np.unique(np.round(np.linspace(0, len(ranked) - 1, min(k, len(ranked)))).astype(int))
1595    return [ranked[i][1] for i in picks]
1596
1597
1598def draw_example(rec, pred: np.ndarray, trace: dict | None, label: str, scale: float = 0.5,
1599                 overlays: dict | None = None, continuation: np.ndarray | None = None):
1600    """One tree as a row of three: the winter trace, the hand mask and the predicted mask, each with the
1601    lines :func:`treeskel.shape.shape_measures` fits (PIL image, resized by ``scale``, then labelled). With
1602    ``overlays``, the hand mask is shown lined up (:func:`hand_mask`); ``continuation`` (from
1603    :func:`draw_completion`) is shown in orange on the predicted mask.
1604
1605    Args:
1606        rec: The tree's record.
1607        pred: Its predicted 256x256 boolean mask.
1608        trace: Its winter trace (``{"trunk", "left", "right"}``), or None.
1609        label: Text written on the row.
1610        scale: Size relative to the photos.
1611        overlays: The mask line-ups; None for the mask as drawn.
1612        continuation: Pixels drawn on by :func:`draw_completion`, or None.
1613
1614    Returns:
1615        The row as a PIL image.
1616    """
1617    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
1618
1619    from treeskel.io import load_tree, mask_to_image_frame
1620    from treeskel.shape import MASK_ZOOM as ZOOM, draw_shape, fitted_lines, mask_to_image
1621
1622    params = ShapeParams()
1623    s = load_tree(rec, "summer")["rgb"]
1624
1625    def on_summer(mask, name, colour, extra=None):
1626        """The summer photo with ``mask`` (``extra`` in orange) shaded and its lines drawn, and its label."""
1627        img = s.copy()
1628        full, _ = mask_to_image_frame(np.asarray(mask, bool))
1629        img[full] = (0.45 * img[full] + 0.55 * np.array(colour)).astype(np.uint8)
1630        if extra is not None and np.any(extra):
1631            more, _ = mask_to_image_frame(np.asarray(extra, bool))
1632            img[more] = (0.3 * img[more] + 0.7 * np.array((255, 150, 0))).astype(np.uint8)
1633        br = mask_branches(mask)
1634        if br is None:
1635            return draw_shape(img, (), {}), f"{name}: no fork found"
1636        lines = {k: tuple(mask_to_image(np.array(v)))
1637                 for k, v in fitted_lines(br["trunk"], br["left"], br["right"], br["fork_radius"], params, ZOOM).items()}
1638        return draw_shape(img, [mask_to_image(br[p]) for p in ("trunk", "left", "right")], lines), name
1639
1640    tiles = []                                             # (image, label)
1641    if trace is not None:
1642        w = load_tree(rec, "winter")["rgb"]
1643        lines = fitted_lines(trace["trunk"], trace["left"], trace["right"], trace["fork_radius"], params)
1644        tiles.append((draw_shape(w, (trace["trunk"], trace["left"], trace["right"]), lines), f"{label}: winter trace"))
1645    hand = hand_mask(rec, overlays)
1646    tiles.append(on_summer(hand, "hand mask, lined up" if overlays is not None else "hand mask", (60, 120, 255))
1647                 if hand is not None else (draw_shape(s, (), {}), "no hand mask used"))
1648    shown = continuation is not None and np.any(continuation)
1649    tiles.append(on_summer(pred, "predicted mask" + (" (orange: predicted on)" if shown else ""), (0, 200, 0),
1650                           continuation))
1651    size = (round(tiles[0][0].width * scale), round(tiles[0][0].height * scale))
1652    out = Image.new("RGB", (size[0] * len(tiles), size[1]))
1653    dr = ImageDraw.Draw(out)
1654    font = ImageFont.load_default(size=14)
1655    for i, (im, text) in enumerate(tiles):
1656        out.paste(im.resize(size, Image.BILINEAR), (i * size[0], 0))
1657        dr.text((i * size[0] + 6, 5), text, fill=(255, 255, 0), font=font, stroke_width=2, stroke_fill=(0, 0, 0))
1658    return out
1659

1705"""The runs drawn (after the hand masks, in this order) in a run's skill figure, where not the default: the
1706angle CNN's two runs, the U-Net on the masks as drawn, the lined-up run and its joined one, up to the run
1707itself. The full-size figures compare the U-Net variants only, so that no more than six series share a row."""
1708
1709
1710def plot_skill(report: dict, path: Path, failed: list[str], others: Sequence[tuple[str, dict]] = ()) -> None:
1711    """The comparison figure of :func:`treeskel.shape_cnn.plot_comparison`, with the segmentation added.
1712
1713    Args:
1714        report: The run's report.
1715        path: The figure file to write.
1716        failed: Files that could not be written are added to it (a viewer can lock a file on Windows).
1717        others: ``(run name, skills per measure)`` of other runs to draw beside it.
1718    """
1719    from treeskel.shape_cnn import plot_comparison
1720
1721    scores = report["scores"]
1722    key = report.get("variant") or ("segment_lined_up" if report.get("mask_overlay") else "segment")
1723    series = [("hand masks", {k: v["hand masks"] for k, v in scores.items()})]
1724    have = dict(others)
1725    have[key] = {k: v["segmentation"] for k, v in scores.items()}
1726    series += [(name, have[name]) for name in figure_runs(key) if name in have]
1727    what = f"masks joined, {report['no_fork']}" if report.get("join") else _n(report["no_fork"], "U-Net mask")
1728    plot_comparison(series, path, failed, names=RUN_NAMES, styles=RUN_STYLES,
1729                    title="A U-Net trained on the hand masks, its masks measured against the winter traces",
1730                    subtitle=f"{report['n_trees']} trees, each from the fold that held its row out; "
1731                             f"{what} with no fork count as the mean shape")
1732
1733
1734def plot_learning(log: Sequence[dict], chosen: Sequence[dict], path: Path, failed: list[str],
1735                  cldice: float = 0.0) -> None:
1736    """Loss against epoch while choosing the epochs (:func:`treeskel.shape_cnn.plot_training`); ``cldice`` is
1737    the recipe's centre-line weight, named on the axis.
1738
1739    Args:
1740        log: The run's training log: one row per fold, stage and epoch, with its losses.
1741        chosen: The epochs each fold chose.
1742        path: The figure file to write.
1743        failed: Files that could not be written are added to it (a viewer can lock a file on Windows).
1744        cldice: The centre-line weight.
1745    """
1746    from treeskel.shape_cnn import plot_training
1747
1748    loss = "cross-entropy + Dice" if not cldice else f"cross-entropy + {1 - cldice:g} Dice + {cldice:g} clDice"
1749    plot_training(log, chosen, path, failed, "U-Net on the hand masks: loss while choosing the epochs",
1750                  ylabel=f"Loss ({loss})")
1751

1753def figure_runs(key: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
1754    """The runs drawn in ``key``'s skill figure, in order (:data:`FIGURE_RUNS`), ``key`` included.
1755
1756    Args:
1757        key: The run's name.
1758
1759    Returns:
1760        The run names.
1761    """
1762    if key in FIGURE_RUNS:
1763        return FIGURE_RUNS[key]
1764    if any(tag in key for tag in ("_seed", "_cldice", "_ensemble")):
1765        # Session 16's samples of the recipe and its variants: drawn beside the named run and its re-run.
1766        if key.endswith("_joined"):
1767            return ("segment_lined_up_joined", "segment_lined_up_rerun_joined", key)
1768        return ("segment_lined_up", "segment_lined_up_rerun", key)
1769    base = ("shape_cnn", "shape_cnn_480x640", "segment", "segment_lined_up", "segment_lined_up_joined")
1770    return base[:base.index(key) + 1] if key in base else base[:3] + (key,)
1771
1772
1773def _other_runs(results: Path, key: str) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
1774    """The saved runs beside ``key``'s that its skill figure draws (:func:`figure_runs`)."""
1775    out = []
1776    for name in figure_runs(key):
1777        p = results / name / "report.json"
1778        if name != key and p.exists():
1779            rep = json.loads(p.read_text())
1780            model = "cnn fine-tuned" if name.startswith("shape_cnn") else "segmentation"
1781            out.append((name, {k: v[model] for k, v in rep["scores"].items()}))
1782    return out
1783
1784
1785def replot(out: Path, figures: Path) -> list[str]:
1786    """The skill and learning-curve figures from a saved run. Returns paths that could not be written.
1787
1788    Args:
1789        out: The run's results folder.
1790        figures: The folder for the figures.
1791
1792    Returns:
1793        Paths that could not be written.
1794    """
1795    failed: list[str] = []
1796    figures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1797    report = json.loads((out / "report.json").read_text())
1798    key = report.get("variant") or ("segment_lined_up" if report.get("mask_overlay") else "segment")
1799    plot_skill(report, figures / f"{out.name}_skill.png", failed, _other_runs(out.parent, key))
1800    if (out / "training_log.csv").exists():                 # a joined run has none: it trained nothing
1801        with open(out / "training_log.csv", newline="") as f:
1802            plot_learning(list(csv.DictReader(f)), report["epochs"], figures / f"{out.name}_training.png", failed,
1803                          report.get("params", {}).get("cldice", 0.0))
1804    return failed
1805

1807def variant(params: SegParams, lined_up: bool = False) -> str:
1808    """The run's name, which is also its results folder: ``segment``, ``segment_depth``, ``segment_resnet34``,
1809    ``segment_lined_up`` (trained on the lined-up masks), ..., then ``_cldice`` for the centre-line loss
1810    (``_cldice0.3`` at another weight than :data:`CLDICE_WEIGHT`) and ``_seed1`` for another seed than 0.
1811
1812    Args:
1813        params: The settings, as :class:`SegParams`.
1814        lined_up: Trained on the lined-up masks.
1815
1816    Returns:
1817        The name.
1818    """
1819    name = "segment" + ("_lined_up" if lined_up else "") + ("_depth" if params.depth else "")
1820    if params.encoder != SegParams.encoder:
1821        name += f"_{params.encoder}"
1822    if whole_photo(params):
1823        name = f"{name}_{input_shape(params)[0]}x{input_shape(params)[1]}"
1824    elif params.size != SegParams.size:
1825        name = f"{name}_{params.size}"
1826    if params.cldice:
1827        name += "_cldice" if params.cldice == CLDICE_WEIGHT else f"_cldice{params.cldice:g}"
1828    return name if params.seed == SegParams.seed else f"{name}_seed{params.seed}"
1829

1831# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
1832# The run
1833# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
1834
1835MASK_COLUMNS = ("iou", "dice", "precision", "recall")
1836
1837OTHER_RUNS = (("shape_cnn", "cnn fine-tuned"), ("shape_cnn_480x640", "cnn fine-tuned"), ("segment", "segmentation"),
1838              ("segment_lined_up", "segmentation"), ("segment_lined_up_joined", "segmentation"))
1839"""The saved runs a new run is compared with tree by tree (results folder, predictions column)."""
1840
1841
1842def against_runs(out: Path, others: Sequence[tuple[str, str]] = OTHER_RUNS) -> dict:
1843    """A run's predictions (``out/predictions.csv``) against each other saved run beside it that exists,
1844    tree by tree (:func:`compare_with`).
1845
1846    Args:
1847        out: The run's results folder.
1848        others: ``(run name, prediction column)`` of the runs to compare with.
1849
1850    Returns:
1851        ``{run name: compare_with(...)}`` for each run found.
1852    """
1853    mine = read_predictions(out / "predictions.csv", "segmentation")
1854    got = {}
1855    for name, column in dict(others).items():
1856        p = out.parent / name / "predictions.csv"
1857        if p.exists() and p.resolve() != (out / "predictions.csv").resolve():
1858            got[name] = compare_with(mine, read_predictions(p, column))
1859    return got
1860
1861
1862def print_against(runs: dict) -> None:
1863    """Print :func:`against_runs`.
1864
1865    Args:
1866        runs: From :func:`against_runs`.
1867    """
1868    for name, measures in runs.items():
1869        print(f"\nAgainst {name}, tree by tree (MAE: {name} -> segmentation; trees predicted more closely; "
1870              "Wilcoxon p):")
1871        for k, c in measures.items():
1872            print(f"  {k:12s} {c['mae_other']:5.1f} -> {c['mae_seg']:5.1f}   {c['closer']:4.0%}   "
1873                  f"p {c['wilcoxon_p']:.1e}")
1874
1875
1876def _value(text: str) -> float:
1877    return float(text) if text else float("nan")
1878
1879
1880def _read_run(src: Path) -> tuple[dict, dict[str, dict]]:
1881    """A saved run's report, and per tree its row, fold and ``(winter, mean shape, hand masks)`` per measure
1882    (from its ``predictions.csv``, in its order)."""
1883    source = json.loads((Path(src) / "report.json").read_text())
1884    info: dict[str, dict] = {}
1885    with open(Path(src) / "predictions.csv", newline="") as f:
1886        for r in csv.DictReader(f):
1887            t = info.setdefault(r["tree"], {"row": int(r["row"]), "fold": int(r["fold"])})
1888            t[r["measure"]] = (_value(r["winter"]), _value(r["mean shape"]), _value(r["hand masks"]))
1889    return source, info
1890
1891
1892def _measure_all(masks: dict[str, np.ndarray], trees: Sequence[str]) -> np.ndarray:
1893    """``(n, len(MEASURES))`` shape measures of each tree's mask (:func:`mask_shape`)."""
1894    out = np.full((len(trees), len(MEASURES)), np.nan)
1895    for i, t in enumerate(trees):
1896        m, _ = mask_shape(masks[t])
1897        out[i] = [m[k] for k in MEASURES]
1898    return out
1899
1900
1901def _rescored_run(src: Path, source: dict, info: dict[str, dict], trees: Sequence[str], final: dict[str, np.ndarray],
1902                  seg: np.ndarray, out: Path, extra: dict, mask_header: Sequence[str], mask_rows: Sequence[Sequence],
1903                  figures: Path | None, sheet: tuple[str, dict, dict] | None, versus: Sequence[tuple[str, str]],
1904                  progress: Callable[[str], None]) -> list[str]:
1905    """Score, print and save a saved run's masks after a change (:func:`joined_run`, :func:`grown_run`).
1906
1907    Args:
1908        src, source, info: The run's folder, report and :func:`_read_run` measures.
1909        trees: The trees, in order.
1910        final: ``{tree: the changed mask}``; ``seg`` their measures (:func:`_measure_all`).
1911        out: The new run's folder.
1912        extra: Report entries of the change (its settings and counts, and the pixel scores).
1913        mask_header, mask_rows: ``mask_scores.csv``.
1914        figures: Where the skill figure and the contact sheet go (None: none).
1915        sheet: ``(name, masks before, masks after)`` for :func:`draw_joins`, or None.
1916        versus: Extra saved runs to compare with tree by tree, beside :data:`OTHER_RUNS`.
1917        progress: Where the printed summary goes.
1918
1919    Returns:
1920        Paths that could not be written.
1921    """
1922    # The saved run's winter measures, its folds' mean shapes and the hand masks' measures, tree by tree.
1923    y, mean, hand = (np.array([[info[t][k][c] for k in MEASURES] for t in trees]) for c in range(3))
1924    folds = np.array([info[t]["fold"] for t in trees])
1925    seg_filled = fill_failures(seg, mean)                   # a mask with no fork counts as the mean shape
1926    # The new report keeps the run's recipe and adds the change's settings and counts.
1927    report = {k: source[k] for k in ("n_masks", "mask_overlay", "params", "device", "weights", "epochs", "minutes")
1928              if k in source}
1929    report.update(n_trees=len(trees), variant=out.name, no_fork=int((~np.isfinite(seg).any(axis=1)).sum()))
1930    report.update(extra)
1931    report.update(scores={}, against_runs={})
1932    # Every source scored against winter, as skill over the mean shape, measure by measure.
1933    for j, k in enumerate(MEASURES):
1934        base = mean[:, j]
1935        mean_shape = evaluate(y[:, j], base, base, folds)
1936        mean_shape["r"] = None
1937        report["scores"][k] = {"mean shape": mean_shape, "hand masks": evaluate(y[:, j], hand[:, j], base, folds),
1938                               "segmentation": evaluate(y[:, j], seg_filled[:, j], base, folds),
1939                               "segmentation, forks found": evaluate(y[:, j], seg[:, j], base, folds)}
1940    for title, names in (("Headline (no reference direction)", HEADLINE), ("From the trunk's axis", TRUNK_RELATIVE),
1941                         ("From the photo's vertical (camera roll adds to these)", VERTICAL)):
1942        progress(f"\n{title}:")
1943        print_scores(report, names)
1944
1945    failed: list[str] = []
1946    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1947
1948    def write(path: Path, fn) -> None:
1949        """Write one output file; a file that cannot be written is listed, not fatal."""
1950        try:
1951            fn(path)
1952        except OSError as e:                                # e.g. open in a viewer on Windows
1953            failed.append(f"{path}: {e.strerror or e}")
1954
1955    def predictions(path):
1956        """Write every tree's measures: winter, the mean shape, the hand masks and the segmentation."""
1957        with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
1958            w = csv.writer(f)
1959            w.writerow(["tree", "row", "fold", "measure", "winter", "mean shape", "hand masks", "segmentation"])
1960            for i, t in enumerate(trees):
1961                for j, k in enumerate(MEASURES):
1962                    w.writerow([t, info[t]["row"], info[t]["fold"], k]
1963                               + ["" if not np.isfinite(v) else f"{v:.2f}"
1964                                  for v in (y[i, j], mean[i, j], hand[i, j], seg_filled[i, j])])
1965
1966    def mask_table(path):
1967        """Write each mask's pixel scores."""
1968        with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
1969            w = csv.writer(f)
1970            w.writerow(mask_header)
1971            w.writerows(mask_rows)
1972
1973    write(out / "predictions.csv", predictions)
1974    write(out / "mask_scores.csv", mask_table)
1975    write(out / "predicted_masks.npz", lambda p: save_masks(p, trees, np.stack([final[t] for t in trees])))
1976    # Tree by tree against the earlier runs, from the predictions just written.
1977    if (out / "predictions.csv").exists():
1978        report["against_runs"] = against_runs(out, tuple(OTHER_RUNS) + tuple(versus))
1979        print_against(report["against_runs"])
1980    write(out / "report.json", lambda p: p.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)))
1981    if figures is not None:
1982        figures = Path(figures)
1983        figures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1984        if (out / "report.json").exists():
1985            failed += replot(out, figures)
1986        if sheet is not None and sheet[1]:
1987            write(figures / f"{out.name}_{sheet[0]}.png", lambda p: draw_joins(sheet[1], sheet[2]).save(p))
1988    progress(f"\nSaved {out}/ (report.json, predictions.csv, mask_scores.csv, predicted_masks.npz)")
1989    return failed
1990
1991
1992def _pixel_columns(src: Path, trees: Sequence[str], final: dict[str, np.ndarray],
1993                   hands: dict[str, np.ndarray] | None) -> tuple[dict, str, dict[str, list]]:
1994    """Pixel scores for a re-scored run: against the hand masks if given, else the run's own (of the masks
1995    before the change). Returns ``(report summary, note, {tree: row values})``."""
1996    rows: dict[str, list] = {}
1997    if hands is not None:
1998        per = {t: mask_scores(final[t], hands[t]) for t in trees if t in hands}
1999        summary = {}
2000        for c in MASK_COLUMNS:
2001            v = np.array([per[t][c] for t in per], float)
2002            v = v[np.isfinite(v)]
2003            summary[c] = {"median": float(np.median(v)) if len(v) else None,
2004                          "mean": float(v.mean()) if len(v) else None, "n": int(len(v))}
2005        for t in trees:
2006            rows[t] = ["" if t not in per or not np.isfinite(per[t][c]) else f"{per[t][c]:.4f}" for c in MASK_COLUMNS]
2007        return summary, "pixel scores of the changed masks against the hand masks", rows
2008    pixel = {}
2009    if (Path(src) / "mask_scores.csv").exists():
2010        with open(Path(src) / "mask_scores.csv", newline="") as f:
2011            pixel = {r["tree"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(f)}
2012    for t in trees:
2013        rows[t] = [pixel.get(t, {}).get(c, "") for c in MASK_COLUMNS]
2014    return json.loads((Path(src) / "report.json").read_text()).get("masks", {}), "pixel scores of the masks before the change", rows
2015
2016
2017def joined_run(src: Path, gap: float = JOIN_GAP, out: Path | None = None, figures: Path | None = None,
2018               progress: Callable[[str], None] = print) -> tuple[Path, list[str]]:
2019    """Score a saved run's masks again after joining their pieces (:func:`join_pieces`).
2020
2021    Everything comes from the run's own files, so no photos are needed:
2022    ``predicted_masks.npz``, and ``predictions.csv`` for each tree's row, fold,
2023    winter and hand-mask measures and its fold's mean shape. The result is a
2024    run like any other (``report.json``, ``predictions.csv``,
2025    ``mask_scores.csv``, ``predicted_masks.npz``), in ``<run>_joined`` (or
2026    ``<run>_joined_<gap>`` for another gap), compared tree by tree with the
2027    run it came from and the other saved runs. Its pixel scores are the
2028    run's own, of the masks before joining (the hand masks are not needed
2029    here); ``mask_scores.csv`` lists the pieces joined and pixels added per tree.
2030
2031    Args:
2032        src: The saved run's folder.
2033        gap: Largest gap joined (:data:`JOIN_GAP`, fixed from geometry).
2034        out: Results folder (default: beside ``src``, as above).
2035        figures: Where the skill figure and the joins' contact sheet go (None: no figures).
2036        progress: Where the printed summary goes.
2037
2038    Returns:
2039        ``(out, paths that could not be written)``.
2040    """
2041    src = Path(src)
2042    source, info = _read_run(src)
2043    masks = load_masks(src / "predicted_masks.npz")
2044    trees = [t for t in info if t in masks]
2045    out = Path(out) if out else src.parent / (f"{src.name}_joined" if gap == JOIN_GAP else f"{src.name}_joined_{gap:g}")
2046    # Join every mask's pieces, counting the pieces joined and the pixels the joins add.
2047    joined, pieces, added = {}, np.zeros(len(trees), int), np.zeros(len(trees), int)
2048    for i, t in enumerate(trees):
2049        joined[t], pieces[i] = join_pieces(masks[t], gap)
2050        added[i] = int((joined[t] & ~masks[t]).sum())
2051    # The measures after joining, and before (re-measured only where a join changed the mask).
2052    seg = _measure_all(joined, trees)
2053    seg0 = seg.copy()
2054    changed = [i for i in range(len(trees)) if pieces[i]]
2055    seg0[changed] = _measure_all(masks, [trees[i] for i in changed])            # unchanged masks: measured once
2056    before, after = np.isfinite(seg0).any(axis=1), np.isfinite(seg).any(axis=1)   # as main: no measure = no fork
2057    v = MEASURES.index("v_opening")
2058    # What the joining did, for the report: masks and pieces joined, and forks found or lost.
2059    join = {"source": str(src), "gap": gap, "masks_joined": int((pieces > 0).sum()),
2060            "pieces_joined": int(pieces.sum()), "pixels_added": int(added.sum()),
2061            "no_fork_before": int((~before).sum()), "no_fork_after": int((~after).sum()),
2062            "v_opening_before": int(np.isfinite(seg0[:, v]).sum()), "v_opening_after": int(np.isfinite(seg[:, v]).sum()),
2063            "forks_found_by_joining": [t for i, t in enumerate(trees) if after[i] and not before[i]],
2064            "forks_lost_by_joining": [t for i, t in enumerate(trees) if before[i] and not after[i]]}
2065    progress(f"Joined pieces within {gap:g} px in {_n(join['masks_joined'], 'mask')} of {len(trees)} "
2066             f"({_n(join['pieces_joined'], 'piece')}, {join['pixels_added']} pixels added); masks with no fork "
2067             f"{join['no_fork_before']} -> {join['no_fork_after']}; with a V opening {join['v_opening_before']} -> "
2068             f"{join['v_opening_after']}")
2069    # Score, print and save like any run, compared tree by tree with the run it came from.
2070    masks_summary, _, pixel = _pixel_columns(src, trees, joined, None)
2071    header = ["tree", "row", "fold", "fork_found", "fork_found_before", "pieces_joined", "pixels_added",
2072              *(f"{c}_before_joining" for c in MASK_COLUMNS)]
2073    rows = [[t, info[t]["row"], info[t]["fold"], int(after[i]), int(before[i]), int(pieces[i]), int(added[i]),
2074             *pixel[t]] for i, t in enumerate(trees)]
2075    moved = [t for i, t in enumerate(trees) if pieces[i]]
2076    failed = _rescored_run(src, source, info, trees, joined, seg, out,
2077                           {"masks": masks_summary, "masks_note": "pixel scores of the masks before joining",
2078                            "join": join},
2079                           header, rows, figures, ("masks", {t: masks[t] for t in moved}, {t: joined[t] for t in moved}),
2080                           ((src.name, "segmentation"),), progress)
2081    return out, failed
2082
2083
2084def grown_run(src: Path, low: float, choice: dict | None = None, hands: dict[str, np.ndarray] | None = None,
2085              gap: float = JOIN_GAP, out: Path | None = None, figures: Path | None = None,
2086              progress: Callable[[str], None] = print) -> tuple[Path, list[str]]:
2087    """Score a saved run's masks again after growing them (:func:`grow_mask`) and joining their pieces.
2088
2089    Like :func:`joined_run`, from the run's own files, plus its
2090    ``probabilities.npz``: each saved mask is grown into the pixels above
2091    ``low`` connected to it, then joined (:func:`join_pieces`), then measured.
2092    The result goes to ``<run>_grown`` and is compared tree by tree with
2093    ``<run>_joined`` (the same network, joined only) and the other saved runs.
2094
2095    Args:
2096        src: The saved run's folder (with ``probabilities.npz``).
2097        low: The lower threshold (chosen by :func:`choose_low`, never on winter).
2098        choice: How ``low`` was chosen (``{str(low): mean clDice}``), for the report.
2099        hands: ``{tree: hand mask}`` for pixel scores of the grown masks (else the run's own, before growing).
2100        gap: The joining gap after growing.
2101        out: Results folder (default ``<run>_grown``).
2102        figures: Where the skill figure and the contact sheet of the most grown masks go (None: none).
2103        progress: Where the printed summary goes.
2104
2105    Returns:
2106        ``(out, paths that could not be written)``.
2107    """
2108    src = Path(src)
2109    source, info = _read_run(src)
2110    masks = load_masks(src / "predicted_masks.npz")
2111    probs = load_probabilities(src / "probabilities.npz")
2112    trees = [t for t in info if t in masks and t in probs]
2113    out = Path(out) if out else src.parent / f"{src.name}_grown"
2114    high = float(source.get("params", {}).get("threshold", 0.5))
2115    # Grow each mask into its connected pixels above ``low`` (hysteresis), then join its pieces.
2116    final, grown_px, pieces = {}, np.zeros(len(trees), int), np.zeros(len(trees), int)
2117    for i, t in enumerate(trees):
2118        grown = grow_mask(probs[t], low, masks[t], high)
2119        grown_px[i] = int((grown & ~masks[t]).sum())
2120        final[t], pieces[i] = join_pieces(grown, gap)
2121    # The comparison is the same masks joined but not grown, so only the growing differs.
2122    seg = _measure_all(final, trees)
2123    joined_only = {t: join_pieces(masks[t], gap)[0] for t in trees}
2124    seg0 = _measure_all(joined_only, trees)
2125    v = MEASURES.index("v_opening")
2126    before, after = np.isfinite(seg0).any(axis=1), np.isfinite(seg).any(axis=1)
2127    change = np.abs(seg - seg0)                             # a measure gained or lost counts as changed
2128    change[np.isnan(seg) != np.isnan(seg0)] = np.inf
2129    moved = np.nan_to_num(change, nan=0.0).max(axis=1)
2130    grow = {"source": str(src), "low": low, "high": high, "chosen_by": "mean clDice against the lined-up hand masks",
2131            "cldice": choice or {}, "masks_grown": int((grown_px > 0).sum()), "pixels_added": int(grown_px.sum()),
2132            "no_fork_joined_only": int((~before).sum()), "no_fork_grown": int((~after).sum()),
2133            "v_opening_joined_only": int(np.isfinite(seg0[:, v]).sum()),
2134            "v_opening_grown": int(np.isfinite(seg[:, v]).sum()),
2135            "masks_whose_measures_changed": int((moved > 0.5).sum())}
2136    progress(f"Grown into pixels above {low:g} connected to each mask: {_n(grow['masks_grown'], 'mask')} of "
2137             f"{len(trees)} grew ({grow['pixels_added']} pixels); then joined within {gap:g} px. Masks with no fork "
2138             f"(joined only -> grown) {grow['no_fork_joined_only']} -> {grow['no_fork_grown']}; with a V opening "
2139             f"{grow['v_opening_joined_only']} -> {grow['v_opening_grown']}; measures moved by more than 0.5 degrees "
2140             f"in {grow['masks_whose_measures_changed']}")
2141    masks_summary, note, pixel = _pixel_columns(src, trees, final, hands)
2142    header = ["tree", "row", "fold", "fork_found", "fork_found_joined_only", "pixels_grown", "pieces_joined",
2143              "largest_change_deg", *(MASK_COLUMNS if hands is not None else
2144                                      tuple(f"{c}_before_growing" for c in MASK_COLUMNS))]
2145    rows = [[t, info[t]["row"], info[t]["fold"], int(after[i]), int(before[i]), int(grown_px[i]), int(pieces[i]),
2146             f"{moved[i]:.2f}", *pixel[t]] for i, t in enumerate(trees)]
2147    top = [trees[i] for i in np.argsort(-moved)[:48] if moved[i] > 0.5]
2148    failed = _rescored_run(src, source, info, trees, final, seg, out,
2149                           {"masks": masks_summary, "masks_note": note, "grow": grow, "join": {"gap": gap}},
2150                           header, rows, figures, ("masks", {t: masks[t] for t in top}, {t: final[t] for t in top}),
2151                           ((src.name, "segmentation"), (f"{src.name}_joined", "segmentation")), progress)
2152    return out, failed
2153
2154
2155def continued_run(src: Path, cone: float = CONTINUE_CONE, out: Path | None = None, figures: Path | None = None,
2156                  progress: Callable[[str], None] = print) -> tuple[Path, list[str]]:
2157    """Score a saved joined run's masks again after continuing short leaders and pruning (:func:`continue_leaders`).
2158
2159    Like :func:`joined_run`, from the run's own files (no photos). ``src`` is a
2160    joined run (e.g. ``segment_lined_up_rerun_joined``); the result goes to
2161    ``<run>_continued`` beside it (``_joined`` dropped from the name) and is
2162    compared tree by tree with ``src`` and the other saved runs. Pixel scores
2163    are the run's own, of the masks before the change.
2164
2165    Args:
2166        src: A saved joined run's folder.
2167        cone: Largest angle (degrees) between a short leader's direction at its tip and a piece it is
2168            continued to.
2169        out: The results folder; ``<run>_continued`` beside ``src`` by default.
2170        figures: The folder for the figures; the run's default by default.
2171        progress: Prints a progress line.
2172
2173    Returns:
2174        ``(out, paths that could not be written)``.
2175    """
2176    src = Path(src)
2177    source, info = _read_run(src)
2178    masks = load_masks(src / "predicted_masks.npz")
2179    trees = [t for t in info if t in masks]
2180    out = Path(out) if out else src.parent / f"{src.name.removesuffix('_joined')}_continued"
2181    final, pieces = {}, np.zeros(len(trees), int)
2182    for i, t in enumerate(trees):
2183        final[t], pieces[i] = continue_leaders(masks[t], cone)
2184    seg, seg0 = _measure_all(final, trees), _measure_all(masks, trees)
2185    v = MEASURES.index("v_opening")
2186    change = np.abs(seg - seg0)
2187    change[np.isnan(seg) != np.isnan(seg0)] = np.inf
2188    moved = np.nan_to_num(change, nan=0.0).max(axis=1)
2189    removed = np.array([int((masks[t] & ~final[t]).sum()) for t in trees])
2190    cont = {"source": str(src), "cone": cone, "masks_continued": int((pieces > 0).sum()),
2191            "pieces_joined": int(pieces.sum()), "pixels_pruned": int(removed.sum()),
2192            "v_opening_before": int(np.isfinite(seg0[:, v]).sum()), "v_opening_after": int(np.isfinite(seg[:, v]).sum()),
2193            "masks_whose_measures_changed": int((moved > 0.5).sum())}
2194    progress(f"Short leaders continued to pieces on their line (within {cone:g} degrees and the missing stretch) in "
2195             f"{_n(cont['masks_continued'], 'mask')} of {len(trees)} ({_n(cont['pieces_joined'], 'piece')}); every mask "
2196             f"cut down to its trunk and two leaders ({cont['pixels_pruned']} pixels removed). With a V opening "
2197             f"{cont['v_opening_before']} -> {cont['v_opening_after']}; measures moved by more than 0.5 degrees in "
2198             f"{cont['masks_whose_measures_changed']}")
2199    masks_summary, _, pixel = _pixel_columns(src, trees, final, None)
2200    header = ["tree", "row", "fold", "fork_found", "pieces_joined", "pixels_pruned", "largest_change_deg",
2201              *(f"{c}_before" for c in MASK_COLUMNS)]
2202    rows = [[t, info[t]["row"], info[t]["fold"], int(np.isfinite(seg[i]).any()), int(pieces[i]), int(removed[i]),
2203             f"{moved[i]:.2f}", *pixel[t]] for i, t in enumerate(trees)]
2204    shown = [t for i, t in enumerate(trees) if pieces[i]] or [trees[i] for i in np.argsort(-moved)[:24]]
2205    failed = _rescored_run(src, source, info, trees, final, seg, out,
2206                           {"masks": masks_summary, "masks_note": "pixel scores of the masks before continuing and pruning",
2207                            "continue": cont, "join": source.get("join", {})},
2208                           header, rows, figures, ("masks", {t: masks[t] for t in shown}, {t: final[t] for t in shown}),
2209                           ((src.name, "segmentation"),), progress)
2210    return out, failed
2211
2212
2213def completed_run(src: Path, out: Path | None = None, figures: Path | None = None,
2214                  progress: Callable[[str], None] = print) -> tuple[Path, list[str]]:
2215    """Score a saved joined run again with its short leaders' lines predicted over the whole stretch.
2216
2217    The model (:func:`fit_completion`) is fitted on the run's own complete
2218    leaders cut short on purpose (:func:`completion_samples`), for each fold
2219    on the other folds' trees only, so no tree's prediction uses its own
2220    leaders; the fit on all trees is kept for the final test. The masks are
2221    not changed. The result goes to ``<run>_completed`` (``_joined`` dropped)
2222    and is compared tree by tree with ``src`` and the other saved runs.
2223
2224    Args:
2225        src: A saved joined run's folder.
2226        out: The results folder; ``<run>_completed`` beside ``src`` by default.
2227        figures: The folder for the figures; the run's default by default.
2228        progress: Prints a progress line.
2229
2230    Returns:
2231        ``(out, paths that could not be written)``.
2232    """
2233    src = Path(src)
2234    source, info = _read_run(src)
2235    masks = load_masks(src / "predicted_masks.npz")
2236    trees = [t for t in info if t in masks]
2237    out = Path(out) if out else src.parent / f"{src.name.removesuffix('_joined')}_completed"
2238    folds = sorted({info[t]["fold"] for t in trees})
2239    samples = {f: completion_samples({t: masks[t] for t in trees if info[t]["fold"] != f}) for f in folds}
2240    coef = {f: fit_completion(samples[f]) for f in folds}
2241    coef_all = fit_completion(completion_samples({t: masks[t] for t in trees}))
2242    seg = np.full((len(trees), len(MEASURES)), np.nan)
2243    done = np.zeros(len(trees), int)
2244    for i, t in enumerate(trees):
2245        m, done[i] = complete_measures(masks[t], coef[info[t]["fold"]])
2246        seg[i] = [m[k] for k in MEASURES]
2247    comp = {"source": str(src), "model": "whole - cut = a*g + c*g*bend (outward line from the vertical)",
2248            "fractions": list(COMPLETE_FRACTIONS), "coef_all": [float(v) for v in coef_all],
2249            "coef_by_fold": {str(f): [float(v) for v in c] for f, c in coef.items()},
2250            "leaders_completed": int(done.sum()), "trees_completed": int((done > 0).sum())}
2251    progress(f"Short leaders' lines predicted over the whole stretch in {_n(comp['trees_completed'], 'tree')} "
2252             f"({_n(comp['leaders_completed'], 'leader')}); model fitted per fold on the other folds' complete leaders "
2253             f"(all trees: a = {coef_all[0]:+.2f}, c = {coef_all[1]:+.3f})")
2254    masks_summary, _, pixel = _pixel_columns(src, trees, masks, None)
2255    header = ["tree", "row", "fold", "fork_found", "leaders_completed", *MASK_COLUMNS]
2256    rows = [[t, info[t]["row"], info[t]["fold"], int(np.isfinite(seg[i]).any()), int(done[i]), *pixel[t]]
2257            for i, t in enumerate(trees)]
2258    failed = _rescored_run(src, source, info, trees, masks, seg, out,
2259                           {"masks": masks_summary, "masks_note": "the masks are not changed", "complete": comp,
2260                            "join": source.get("join", {})},
2261                           header, rows, figures, None, ((src.name, "segmentation"),), progress)
2262    return out, failed
2263
2264
2265def draw_joins(before: dict[str, np.ndarray], after: dict[str, np.ndarray], columns: int = 8, scale: float = 0.5):
2266    """A contact sheet of joined masks: each tile the mask (grey), the pixels the join added (magenta) and the
2267    centre lines and fitted lines found after joining; masks whose V opening could be measured only after
2268    joining come first, labelled. A PIL image; needs no photos.
2269
2270    Args:
2271        before: Masks per tree id before joining (every one is drawn).
2272        after: The same trees' masks after joining.
2273        columns: Tiles per row.
2274        scale: Tile size relative to the masks' frame.
2275
2276    Returns:
2277        The contact sheet (PIL image).
2278    """
2279    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
2280
2281    from treeskel.shape import draw_shape, fitted_lines
2282
2283    params = ShapeParams()
2284    order = sorted(before, key=lambda t: (np.isfinite(mask_shape(before[t])[0]["v_opening"]), t))
2285    size = round(256 * scale)
2286    rows = math.ceil(len(order) / columns)
2287    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (columns * size, rows * size), (20, 20, 20))
2288    font = ImageFont.load_default(size=11)
2289    for i, t in enumerate(order):
2290        b, a = np.asarray(before[t], bool), np.asarray(after[t], bool)
2291        rgb = np.full(b.shape + (3,), 20, np.uint8)
2292        rgb[b] = (150, 150, 150)
2293        rgb[a & ~b] = (235, 80, 235)
2294        br = mask_branches(a)
2295        if br is None:
2296            im = draw_shape(rgb, (), {})
2297        else:
2298            lines = fitted_lines(br["trunk"], br["left"], br["right"], br["fork_radius"], params, MASK_ZOOM)
2299            im = draw_shape(rgb, [br[p] for p in ("trunk", "left", "right")], lines)
2300        tile = im.resize((size, size), Image.BILINEAR)
2301        found = not np.isfinite(mask_shape(b)[0]["v_opening"]) and np.isfinite(mask_shape(a)[0]["v_opening"])
2302        ImageDraw.Draw(tile).text((4, 3), t + ("  V measured" if found else ""), fill=(255, 255, 0), font=font,
2303                                  stroke_width=1, stroke_fill=(0, 0, 0))
2304        sheet.paste(tile, ((i % columns) * size, (i // columns) * size))
2305    return sheet
2306
2307
2308def _grow_and_score(run: Path, hands: dict[str, np.ndarray], gap: float, figures: Path | None,
2309                    low: float | None = None) -> list[str]:
2310    """Choose the lower threshold on the hand masks (unless given) and score the run's grown masks."""
2311    print("\n--- The same masks grown into the less sure pixels connected to them, then joined ---")
2312    if low is None:
2313        print("Choosing the lower threshold by the hand masks' centre lines (mean clDice; the winter traces play "
2314              "no part):", flush=True)
2315        probs = load_probabilities(run / "probabilities.npz")
2316        seeds = load_masks(run / "predicted_masks.npz")
2317        low, choice = choose_low(probs, seeds, hands, gap=gap, progress=lambda m: print(m, flush=True))
2318        print(f"Chosen: {low:g}", flush=True)
2319    else:
2320        choice = None
2321    return grown_run(run, low, choice, hands or None, gap, figures=figures)[1]
2322
2323
2324def _grow_command(args) -> int:
2325    """``--grow DIR``: grow a saved run's masks, with ``--grow-low`` or a threshold chosen on the hand masks."""
2326    run = Path(args.grow)
2327    if args.grow_low is None and not args.data_dirs:
2328        print("Choosing the lower threshold needs the hand masks: give the dataset folder(s), or --grow-low.")
2329        return 1
2330    hands: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
2331    if args.data_dirs:
2332        from treeskel.io import index_dataset
2333        from treeskel.summer_gt import load_overlays
2334
2335        source = json.loads((run / "report.json").read_text())
2336        overlays = load_overlays(source["mask_overlay"]) if source.get("mask_overlay") else None
2337        records = {t.tree_id: t for d in args.data_dirs for t in index_dataset(d).trees}
2338        for t in load_masks(run / "predicted_masks.npz"):
2339            hm = hand_mask(records[t], overlays) if t in records else None
2340            if hm is not None:
2341                hands[t] = hm
2342    failed = _grow_and_score(run, hands, args.join_gap, Path(args.figures), args.grow_low)
2343    for f in failed:
2344        print(f"Could not write {f}")
2345    return 1 if failed else 0
2346
2347
2348def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
2349    """Train on the development rows' hand masks, fold by fold, and score the masks and their shape
2350    (or, with ``--replot``, only redraw the figures from a saved run).
2351
2352    Args:
2353        argv: Command-line arguments; ``None`` reads ``sys.argv[1:]``.
2354
2355    Returns:
2356        The exit status: 0 on success, 1 if the output folder already holds a run, the table holds test-row
2357        trees, too few trees or no lined-up masks were found, PyTorch is missing, the GPU ran out of memory,
2358        or an output file could not be written (each is reported).
2359    """
2360    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m treeskel.segment", description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
2361    ap.add_argument("data_dirs", nargs="*", help="dataset folder(s) with the summer photos and hand masks")
2362    ap.add_argument("--table", default="data/shape/shape_measures.csv", help="winter measures (treeskel.shape)")
2363    ap.add_argument("--traces", default="data/shape/winter_traces.npz", help="winter traces, for the example figure")
2364    ap.add_argument("--split", default="splits.json")
2365    ap.add_argument("--out", help="results folder (default: docs/results/<the run's name>)")
2366    ap.add_argument("--figures", default="docs/figures", help="folder for the figures")
2367    ap.add_argument("--device", help="cuda or cpu (default: the GPU if there is one)")
2368    ap.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=SegParams.epochs, help="most epochs tried")
2369    ap.add_argument("--size", type=int, nargs="+", default=[SegParams.size], metavar="N",
2370                    help="one number: side of the square input, the masks' frame (default 256); two, H W: the "
2371                         "whole photo at that size, e.g. 480 640 (each divisible by 32)")
2372    ap.add_argument("--encoder", default=SegParams.encoder, choices=("resnet18", "resnet34"))
2373    ap.add_argument("--depth", action="store_true", help="also give the network the summer depth")
2374    ap.add_argument("--mask-overlay", metavar="JSON",
2375                    help="train on the hand masks lined up with treeskel.annotate_mask (e.g. "
2376                         "annotations/mask_overlay.json); only lined-up trees train")
2377    ap.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=SegParams.batch,
2378                    help="photos per training step (smaller if the GPU runs out of memory; recorded in the report)")
2379    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=SegParams.seed,
2380                    help="random seed; another seed is another sample of the recipe (named _seed<n>)")
2381    ap.add_argument("--cldice", nargs="?", type=float, const=CLDICE_WEIGHT, default=0.0, metavar="ALPHA",
2382                    help=f"add the soft centre-line Dice to the loss, at weight ALPHA (default {CLDICE_WEIGHT:g}): "
2383                         "BCE + (1 - ALPHA) Dice + ALPHA clDice")
2384    ap.add_argument("--no-grow", action="store_true",
2385                    help="skip scoring the grown masks after training (session 12's idea, not adopted)")
2386    ap.add_argument("--examples", type=int, default=6, help="trees in the example figure")
2387    ap.add_argument("--replot", metavar="DIR", help="only redraw the figures from this results folder")
2388    ap.add_argument("--join", metavar="DIR",
2389                    help="only score a saved run's masks again with their pieces joined (writes DIR_joined)")
2390    ap.add_argument("--join-gap", type=float, default=JOIN_GAP,
2391                    help=f"largest gap joined, mask px (default {JOIN_GAP:g}: about a trunk's width, fixed)")
2392    ap.add_argument("--grow", metavar="DIR",
2393                    help="only score a saved run's masks again, grown into the less sure pixels connected to them "
2394                         "and joined (writes DIR_grown); the lower threshold is --grow-low, or chosen on the hand "
2395                         "masks if the dataset folder(s) are given")
2396    ap.add_argument("--grow-low", type=float, help="the lower threshold for --grow (default: chosen by clDice)")
2397    ap.add_argument("--complete", metavar="DIR",
2398                    help="only score a saved joined run again with its short leaders' lines predicted over the "
2399                         "whole stretch from complete leaders' shapes (writes <run>_completed)")
2400    ap.add_argument("--continue", dest="continue_run", metavar="DIR",
2401                    help="only score a saved joined run's masks again with short leaders continued to pieces on their "
2402                         "line, and cut down to the trunk and two leaders (writes <run>_continued)")
2403    ap.add_argument("--overwrite", action="store_true", help="train even if the results folder holds a run")
2404    ap.add_argument("--random-weights", action="store_true", help="skip the ImageNet weights (tests only)")
2405    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
2406
2407    if args.replot:
2408        failed = replot(Path(args.replot), Path(args.figures))
2409        print(f"Saved the figures in {args.figures}")
2410        for f in failed:
2411            print(f"Could not write {f}")
2412        return 1 if failed else 0
2413    if args.join:
2414        out, failed = joined_run(Path(args.join), args.join_gap, Path(args.out) if args.out else None,
2415                                 Path(args.figures))
2416        for f in failed:
2417            print(f"Could not write {f}")
2418        return 1 if failed else 0
2419    if args.grow:
2420        return _grow_command(args)
2421    if args.complete:
2422        out, failed = completed_run(Path(args.complete), out=Path(args.out) if args.out else None,
2423                                    figures=Path(args.figures))
2424        for f in failed:
2425            print(f"Could not write {f}")
2426        return 1 if failed else 0
2427    if args.continue_run:
2428        out, failed = continued_run(Path(args.continue_run), out=Path(args.out) if args.out else None,
2429                                    figures=Path(args.figures))
2430        for f in failed:
2431            print(f"Could not write {f}")
2432        return 1 if failed else 0
2433    if not args.data_dirs:
2434        ap.error("give the dataset folder(s), or --replot, --join, --grow, --continue or --complete")
2435    if len(args.size) > 2 or any(v % 32 for v in args.size):
2436        ap.error(f"--size takes one or two numbers, each divisible by 32; got {args.size}")
2437    size = args.size[0] if len(args.size) == 1 else (args.size[0], args.size[1])
2438
2439    from treeskel.io import index_dataset
2440
2441    if not 0 <= args.cldice <= 1:
2442        ap.error(f"--cldice takes a weight between 0 and 1; got {args.cldice:g}")
2443    params = SegParams(size=size, encoder=args.encoder, epochs=args.epochs, batch=args.batch, seed=args.seed,
2444                       depth=args.depth, cldice=args.cldice)
2445    out = Path(args.out or f"docs/results/{variant(params, args.mask_overlay is not None)}")
2446    if (out / "report.json").exists() and not args.overwrite:
2447        print(f"{out} already holds a run. Give another --out (e.g. {out}_2), or --overwrite to replace it.")
2448        return 1
2449    split = json.loads(Path(args.split).read_text())
2450    test_rows = set(split["test_rows"])
2451    table = load_table(args.table)
2452    if any(r["row"] in test_rows for r in table):
2453        print("The table holds test-row trees; they are never used here. Stopping.")
2454        return 1
2455    records = {t.tree_id: t for d in args.data_dirs for t in index_dataset(d).trees}
2456    by_id = {r["tree"]: r for r in table}
2457    trees = sorted(t for t in by_id if t in records and records[t].row not in test_rows)
2458    if len(trees) < 3:
2459        print(f"Only {len(trees)} trees have both measures and photos; nothing to train.")
2460        return 1
2461    try:
2462        import torch  # noqa: F401
2463        import torchvision  # noqa: F401
2464    except ImportError as e:
2465        print(f"PyTorch and torchvision are needed: {e}")
2466        return 1
2467    what = "photos, depth and hand masks" if params.depth else "photos and hand masks"
2468    frame = "whole photos" if whole_photo(params) else "masks' frame"
2469    print(f"{len(trees)} development trees; loading the summer {what} ({frame}) at "
2470          f"{input_shape(params)[0]}x{input_shape(params)[1]}...", flush=True)
2471    overlays = None
2472    if args.mask_overlay:
2473        from treeskel.summer_gt import load_overlays
2474
2475        overlays = load_overlays(args.mask_overlay)
2476        if not overlays:
2477            print(f"No lined-up masks in {args.mask_overlay}. Stopping.")
2478            return 1
2479    images, masks, has = load_frames(records, trees, params.size, params.depth, lambda m: print(m, flush=True),
2480                                     overlays)
2481    print(f"{int(has.sum())} of them have a hand mask to train on"
2482          + (f" (lined up; {sum(1 for t in trees if t in overlays and overlays[t].skip)} skipped, "
2483             f"{sum(1 for t in trees if records[t].has_mask and t not in overlays)} not lined up yet)"
2484             if overlays is not None else ""), flush=True)
2485    rows = np.array([by_id[t]["row"] for t in trees])
2486    t0 = time.time()
2487    try:
2488        cv = cross_validate_seg(images, masks, has, rows, split["fold_val_rows"], params, args.device,
2489                                pretrained=not args.random_weights, progress=lambda m: print(m, flush=True))
2490    except (OSError, RuntimeError) as e:                   # a failed weights download, or out of GPU memory
2491        print(f"Training stopped: {type(e).__name__}: {e}\nIf the GPU ran out of memory, close other programs "
2492              "using it (nvidia-smi lists them) and try again, or add --batch 4.")
2493        return 1
2494    minutes = round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1)
2495
2496    # Score every predicted tree: its mask against the hand mask, its shape against the winter trace.
2497    from treeskel.io import MASK_SHAPE
2498
2499    done = cv["fold"] >= 0
2500    pred_masks = np.zeros((len(trees),) + MASK_SHAPE, bool)
2501    probs = np.zeros((len(trees),) + MASK_SHAPE, np.float32)          # in the masks' frame, for growing
2502    seg = np.full((len(trees), len(MEASURES)), np.nan)
2503    scores = {t: dict.fromkeys(MASK_COLUMNS, float("nan")) for t in trees}
2504    for i, t in enumerate(trees):
2505        if not done[i]:
2506            continue
2507        probs[i] = prob_frame(cv["prob"][i], whole_photo(params))
2508        pred_masks[i] = probs[i] > params.threshold                  # as to_mask_size
2509        m, _ = mask_shape(pred_masks[i])
2510        seg[i] = [m[k] for k in MEASURES]
2511        if has[i]:
2512            scores[t] = mask_scores(pred_masks[i], hand_mask(records[t], overlays))   # the mask it was trained on
2513    y = np.array([[by_id[t][f"winter_{k}"] for k in MEASURES] for t in trees], float)
2514    hand = np.array([[by_id[t][f"hand_{k}"] for k in MEASURES] for t in trees], float)
2515    mean = np.full_like(y, np.nan)
2516    for f in sorted(set(cv["fold"][done].tolist())):
2517        va = cv["fold"] == f
2518        with warnings.catch_warnings():
2519            warnings.simplefilter("ignore", RuntimeWarning)
2520            mean[va] = np.nanmean(y[~va], axis=0)          # the fold's training rows' mean shape, as shape_cnn
2521    no_fork = int((done & ~np.isfinite(seg).any(axis=1)).sum())
2522    seg_filled = fill_failures(seg, mean)
2523
2524    report = {"n_trees": int(done.sum()), "n_masks": int((done & has).sum()),
2525              "variant": out.name, "recipe": variant(params, overlays is not None),   # its folder; its settings' name
2526              "mask_overlay": args.mask_overlay,
2527              "params": asdict(params), "device": cv["device"],
2528              "weights": "random" if args.random_weights else "IMAGENET1K_V1", "epochs": cv["epochs"],
2529              "minutes": minutes, "no_fork": no_fork, "masks": {}, "scores": {}, "against_runs": {}}
2530    for c in MASK_COLUMNS:
2531        v = np.array([scores[t][c] for t in trees])[done & has]
2532        v = v[np.isfinite(v)]
2533        report["masks"][c] = {"median": float(np.median(v)) if len(v) else None,
2534                              "mean": float(v.mean()) if len(v) else None, "n": int(len(v))}
2535    folds = cv["fold"]
2536    for j, k in enumerate(MEASURES):
2537        base = mean[:, j]
2538        mean_shape = evaluate(y[:, j], base, base, folds)
2539        mean_shape["r"] = None
2540        report["scores"][k] = {"mean shape": mean_shape, "hand masks": evaluate(y[:, j], hand[:, j], base, folds),
2541                               "segmentation": evaluate(y[:, j], seg_filled[:, j], base, folds),
2542                               "segmentation, forks found": evaluate(y[:, j], seg[:, j], base, folds)}
2543
2544    print(f"\nPredicted masks against the hand masks ({report['n_masks']} trees; median, mean):")
2545    for c in MASK_COLUMNS:
2546        s = report["masks"][c]
2547        if s["n"]:
2548            print(f"  {c:9s} {s['median']:.3f}  {s['mean']:.3f}")
2549    print(f"No fork found in {_n(no_fork, 'predicted mask')} (scored as the mean shape)")
2550    for title, names in (("Headline (no reference direction)", HEADLINE), ("From the trunk's axis", TRUNK_RELATIVE),
2551                         ("From the photo's vertical (camera roll adds to these)", VERTICAL)):
2552        print(f"\n{title}:")
2553        print_scores(report, names)
2554
2555    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2556    failed: list[str] = []
2557
2558    def write(path: Path, fn) -> None:
2559        """Write one output file; a file that cannot be written is listed, not fatal."""
2560        try:
2561            fn(path)
2562        except OSError as e:                                # e.g. open in a viewer on Windows
2563            failed.append(f"{path}: {e.strerror or e}")
2564
2565    def predictions(path):
2566        """Write every tree's measures: winter, the mean shape, the hand masks and the segmentation."""
2567        with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
2568            w = csv.writer(f)
2569            w.writerow(["tree", "row", "fold", "measure", "winter", "mean shape", "hand masks", "segmentation"])
2570            for i, t in enumerate(trees):
2571                if done[i]:
2572                    for j, k in enumerate(MEASURES):
2573                        w.writerow([t, int(rows[i]), int(folds[i]), k]
2574                                   + ["" if not np.isfinite(v) else f"{v:.2f}"
2575                                      for v in (y[i, j], mean[i, j], hand[i, j], seg_filled[i, j])])
2576
2577    def mask_table(path):
2578        """Write each mask's pixel scores against its hand mask."""
2579        with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
2580            w = csv.writer(f)
2581            w.writerow(["tree", "row", "fold", "fork_found", *MASK_COLUMNS])
2582            for i, t in enumerate(trees):
2583                if done[i]:
2584                    w.writerow([t, int(rows[i]), int(folds[i]), int(np.isfinite(seg[i]).any())]
2585                               + ["" if not np.isfinite(scores[t][c]) else f"{scores[t][c]:.4f}" for c in MASK_COLUMNS])
2586
2587    def training_log(path):
2588        """Write the training and validation loss of every epoch and fold."""
2589        with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
2590            w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["fold", "stage", "epoch", "train_loss", "val_loss"])
2591            w.writeheader()
2592            w.writerows(cv["log"])
2593
2594    write(out / "predictions.csv", predictions)
2595    write(out / "mask_scores.csv", mask_table)
2596    write(out / "training_log.csv", training_log)
2597    write(out / "predicted_masks.npz", lambda p: save_masks(p, [t for i, t in enumerate(trees) if done[i]],
2598                                                            pred_masks[done]))
2599    write(out / "probabilities.npz", lambda p: save_probabilities(p, [t for i, t in enumerate(trees) if done[i]],
2600                                                                  probs[done]))
2601    # Tree by tree against the other runs, on the same trees and folds.
2602    if (out / "predictions.csv").exists():
2603        report["against_runs"] = against_runs(out)
2604        print_against(report["against_runs"])
2605    write(out / "report.json", lambda p: p.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)))
2606
2607    figures = Path(args.figures)
2608    figures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2609    if (out / "report.json").exists() and (out / "training_log.csv").exists():
2610        failed += replot(out, figures)
2611    if args.examples > 0:
2612        from PIL import Image
2613
2614        from treeskel.shape import load_traces
2615
2616        traces = load_traces(args.traces) if Path(args.traces).exists() else {}
2617        picks = example_trees({t: scores[t]["dice"] for i, t in enumerate(trees) if done[i]}, args.examples)
2618        tiles = []
2619        for t in picks:
2620            i = trees.index(t)
2621            label = f"{t}  Dice {scores[t]['dice']:.2f}"
2622            tiles.append(draw_example(records[t], pred_masks[i], traces.get(t), label, overlays=overlays))
2623        if tiles:
2624            sheet = Image.new("RGB", (max(im.width for im in tiles), sum(im.height for im in tiles)))
2625            ytop = 0
2626            for im in tiles:
2627                sheet.paste(im, (0, ytop))
2628                ytop += im.height
2629            write(figures / f"{out.name}_examples.jpg", lambda p: sheet.save(p, quality=85))
2630    print(f"\nTrained in {minutes} min on {cv['device']}. Saved {out}/ (report.json, predictions.csv, "
2631          f"mask_scores.csv, training_log.csv, predicted_masks.npz) and the figures in {figures}/")
2632    if (out / "predictions.csv").exists() and (out / "predicted_masks.npz").exists():
2633        print(f"\n--- The same masks with their pieces joined (gaps up to {args.join_gap:g} px) ---")
2634        failed += joined_run(out, args.join_gap, figures=figures)[1]
2635    if (out / "predictions.csv").exists() and (out / "probabilities.npz").exists() and not args.no_grow:
2636        hands = {t: hand_mask(records[t], overlays) for i, t in enumerate(trees) if done[i] and has[i]}
2637        failed += _grow_and_score(out, hands, args.join_gap, figures)
2638    for f in failed:
2639        print(f"Could not write {f}")
2640    return 0

2644    raise SystemExit(main())
CLDICE_WEIGHT = 0.5

α of the centre-line loss when it is switched on (--cldice, session 16): the loss is BCE + (1 − α)·Dice + α·clDice, Shit et al.'s (2021) combination (1 − α)·Dice + α·clDice at their public implementation's default α = 0.5 (checked in their repository, soft_dice_cldice), with the named recipe's cross-entropy kept. Fixed before any run; not tuned.

CL_ITERS = 25

Erosions of the soft skeleton (soft_skeleton()). A branch whose distance transform peaks at d px needs d − 1 erosions, or the centre line of its wide parts is missing (checked on synthetic bars and discs, tests/test_segment_cldice.py), and the loss would then ignore the trunk. The development hand masks' trunk radius at the fork reaches 14.8 mask px (448 trees), their widest point 17.0 on the 21 local development trees (the base of the trunk is drawn wider), 19.0 at the augmentation's largest zoom (1/√0.8). 25 leaves room for wider trunks on the trees not in the repository: an erosion past a branch's width adds nothing, so too many cost only time. (The authors' implementation uses 10, for thin vessels.) Fixed before any run.

187@dataclass(frozen=True)
188class SegParams:
189    """The training recipe, fixed before any result.
190
191    Attributes:
192        size: One number: the side of a square input, the photo's centre
193            480x480 (the hand masks' frame) resized; 256 is the masks' own
194            resolution. Two, ``(height, width)``: the whole photo resized,
195            e.g. ``(480, 640)`` at full size (session 12), where the hand
196            masks cover only the centre columns and the rest is unknown to
197            the loss (:func:`known_columns`). Each side must divide by 32.
198        encoder: ``"resnet18"`` or ``"resnet34"``.
199        epochs: Most epochs tried when choosing the number of epochs.
200        batch: Photos per training step.
201        lr_encoder: Learning rate of the pretrained encoder (AdamW).
202        lr_decoder: Learning rate of the new decoder.
203        weight_decay: AdamW's weight decay.
204        crop: Smallest random crop, as a fraction of the frame's area.
205        rotate: Largest random rotation, degrees either way.
206        jitter: Brightness, contrast and saturation are scaled by up to
207            ``1 ± jitter``.
208        threshold: Probability above which a pixel is branch.
209        seed: Random seed (each training run adds its own offset).
210        depth: Also give the network the summer depth, as a fourth channel.
211        cldice: Weight ``α`` of the soft centre-line Dice in the loss
212            (:func:`seg_loss`, session 16): ``BCE + (1 − α)·Dice + α·clDice``.
213            0, the named recipe, leaves the loss as it was.
214        cl_iters: Erosions of the soft skeleton (:func:`soft_skeleton`); only
215            used when ``cldice`` > 0 (:data:`CL_ITERS`).
216    """
217
218    size: int | tuple[int, int] = 256
219    encoder: str = "resnet18"
220    epochs: int = 60
221    batch: int = 8
222    lr_encoder: float = 1e-4
223    lr_decoder: float = 1e-3
224    weight_decay: float = 1e-4
225    crop: float = 0.8
226    rotate: float = 10.0
227    jitter: float = 0.2
228    threshold: float = 0.5
229    seed: int = 0
230    depth: bool = False
231    cldice: float = 0.0
232    cl_iters: int = CL_ITERS

def known_columns(width: int) -> tuple[int, int]: 
259def known_columns(width: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
260    """The columns ``[start, stop)`` of a whole photo resized to ``width`` that the hand masks describe (the
261    photo's columns 80-559, :data:`treeskel.io.CROP_COLS`); outside them a mask says nothing.
262
263    Args:
264        width: The resized photo's width (px).
265
266    Returns:
267        ``(start, stop)`` column indices.
268
269    Example:
270        >>> known_columns(640), known_columns(320)
271        ((80, 560), (40, 280))
272    """
273    from treeskel.io import CROP_COLS, IMAGE_SHAPE
274
275    return round(CROP_COLS[0] * width / IMAGE_SHAPE[1]), round(CROP_COLS[1] * width / IMAGE_SHAPE[1])

def known_map(params: SegParams) -> numpy.ndarray | None: 
278def known_map(params: SegParams) -> np.ndarray | None:
279    """``(height, width)`` float32, 1 where the hand masks say something and 0 where they do not; None for the
280    masks' own square frame, where they describe every pixel.
281
282    Args:
283        params: The settings, as :class:`SegParams`.
284
285    Returns:
286        The weight map, or None.
287    """
288    if not whole_photo(params):
289        return None
290    h, w = input_shape(params)
291    out = np.zeros((h, w), np.float32)
292    a, b = known_columns(w)
293    out[:, a:b] = 1.0
294    return out

(height, width) float32, 1 where the hand masks say something and 0 where they do not; None for the masks' own square frame, where they describe every pixel.

def mask_to_photo(mask: numpy.ndarray, shape: tuple[int, int]) -> numpy.ndarray: 
297def mask_to_photo(mask: np.ndarray, shape: tuple[int, int]) -> np.ndarray:
298    """A 256x256 hand mask placed on the whole photo (:func:`treeskel.io.mask_to_image_frame`, but resized
299    bilinearly, so soft at the edges as in the square frame) and resized to ``shape`` = ``(height, width)``:
300    uint8 0-255, zero outside the columns it describes.
301
302    Args:
303        mask: A 256x256 boolean hand mask.
304        shape: The output's ``(height, width)``.
305
306    Returns:
307        The ``(height, width)`` uint8 mask.
308    """
309    from PIL import Image
310
311    from treeskel.io import CROP_COLS, IMAGE_SHAPE
312
313    side = IMAGE_SHAPE[0]
314    big = np.asarray(Image.fromarray(np.asarray(mask, bool).astype(np.uint8) * 255).resize((side, side),
315                                                                                            Image.BILINEAR))
316    full = np.zeros(IMAGE_SHAPE, np.uint8)
317    full[:, CROP_COLS[0]:CROP_COLS[1]] = big
318    if tuple(shape) == IMAGE_SHAPE:
319        return full
320    return np.asarray(Image.fromarray(full).resize((shape[1], shape[0]), Image.BILINEAR))

A 256x256 hand mask placed on the whole photo (treeskel.io.mask_to_image_frame(), but resized bilinearly, so soft at the edges as in the square frame) and resized to shape = (height, width): uint8 0-255, zero outside the columns it describes.

Arguments:
  • mask: A 256x256 boolean hand mask.
  • shape: The output's (height, width).
Returns:

The (height, width) uint8 mask.

def make_encoder(name: str = 'resnet18', pretrained: bool = True, channels: int = 3): 
335def make_encoder(name: str = "resnet18", pretrained: bool = True, channels: int = 3):
336    """A torchvision ResNet (18 or 34) for the encoder; with ``channels=4`` its first convolution takes a
337    depth channel too, whose weights start as the mean of the colour weights (as
338    :func:`treeskel.shape_cnn.make_model`).
339
340    Args:
341        name: ``"resnet18"`` or ``"resnet34"``.
342        pretrained: Load the ImageNet weights.
343        channels: Input channels: 3 (colour) or 4 (colour and depth).
344
345    Returns:
346        The torchvision ResNet.
347
348    Raises:
349        ValueError: If ``channels`` is not 3 or 4, or ``name`` is not one of the two.
350    """
351    import torch
352    from torchvision import models
353
354    if name not in ("resnet18", "resnet34"):
355        raise ValueError(f"encoder must be resnet18 or resnet34, got {name!r}")
356    weights = {"resnet18": models.ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1,
357               "resnet34": models.ResNet34_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1}[name]
358    net = getattr(models, name)(weights=weights if pretrained else None)
359    if channels == 4:
360        old = net.conv1
361        net.conv1 = torch.nn.Conv2d(4, old.out_channels, old.kernel_size, old.stride, old.padding, bias=False)
362        with torch.no_grad():
363            net.conv1.weight[:, :3] = old.weight
364            net.conv1.weight[:, 3] = old.weight.mean(dim=1)
365    elif channels != 3:
366        raise ValueError(f"channels must be 3 or 4, got {channels}")
367    return net
