def joined_run( src: pathlib._local.Path, gap: float = 19.3, out: pathlib._local.Path | None = None, figures: pathlib._local.Path | None = None, progress: Callable[[str], None] = <built-in function print>) -> tuple[pathlib._local.Path, list[str]]: 
2018def joined_run(src: Path, gap: float = JOIN_GAP, out: Path | None = None, figures: Path | None = None,
2019               progress: Callable[[str], None] = print) -> tuple[Path, list[str]]:
2020    """Score a saved run's masks again after joining their pieces (:func:`join_pieces`).
2021
2022    Everything comes from the run's own files, so no photos are needed:
2023    ``predicted_masks.npz``, and ``predictions.csv`` for each tree's row, fold,
2024    winter and hand-mask measures and its fold's mean shape. The result is a
2025    run like any other (``report.json``, ``predictions.csv``,
2026    ``mask_scores.csv``, ``predicted_masks.npz``), in ``<run>_joined`` (or
2027    ``<run>_joined_<gap>`` for another gap), compared tree by tree with the
2028    run it came from and the other saved runs. Its pixel scores are the
2029    run's own, of the masks before joining (the hand masks are not needed
2030    here); ``mask_scores.csv`` lists the pieces joined and pixels added per tree.
2031
2032    Args:
2033        src: The saved run's folder.
2034        gap: Largest gap joined (:data:`JOIN_GAP`, fixed from geometry).
2035        out: Results folder (default: beside ``src``, as above).
2036        figures: Where the skill figure and the joins' contact sheet go (None: no figures).
2037        progress: Where the printed summary goes.
2038
2039    Returns:
2040        ``(out, paths that could not be written)``.
2041    """
2042    src = Path(src)
2043    source, info = _read_run(src)
2044    masks = load_masks(src / "predicted_masks.npz")
2045    trees = [t for t in info if t in masks]
2046    out = Path(out) if out else src.parent / (f"{src.name}_joined" if gap == JOIN_GAP else f"{src.name}_joined_{gap:g}")
2047    # Join every mask's pieces, counting the pieces joined and the pixels the joins add.
2048    joined, pieces, added = {}, np.zeros(len(trees), int), np.zeros(len(trees), int)
2049    for i, t in enumerate(trees):
2050        joined[t], pieces[i] = join_pieces(masks[t], gap)
2051        added[i] = int((joined[t] & ~masks[t]).sum())
2052    # The measures after joining, and before (re-measured only where a join changed the mask).
2053    seg = _measure_all(joined, trees)
2054    seg0 = seg.copy()
2055    changed = [i for i in range(len(trees)) if pieces[i]]
2056    seg0[changed] = _measure_all(masks, [trees[i] for i in changed])            # unchanged masks: measured once
2057    before, after = np.isfinite(seg0).any(axis=1), np.isfinite(seg).any(axis=1)   # as main: no measure = no fork
2058    v = MEASURES.index("v_opening")
2059    # What the joining did, for the report: masks and pieces joined, and forks found or lost.
2060    join = {"source": str(src), "gap": gap, "masks_joined": int((pieces > 0).sum()),
2061            "pieces_joined": int(pieces.sum()), "pixels_added": int(added.sum()),
2062            "no_fork_before": int((~before).sum()), "no_fork_after": int((~after).sum()),
2063            "v_opening_before": int(np.isfinite(seg0[:, v]).sum()), "v_opening_after": int(np.isfinite(seg[:, v]).sum()),
2064            "forks_found_by_joining": [t for i, t in enumerate(trees) if after[i] and not before[i]],
2065            "forks_lost_by_joining": [t for i, t in enumerate(trees) if before[i] and not after[i]]}
2066    progress(f"Joined pieces within {gap:g} px in {_n(join['masks_joined'], 'mask')} of {len(trees)} "
2067             f"({_n(join['pieces_joined'], 'piece')}, {join['pixels_added']} pixels added); masks with no fork "
2068             f"{join['no_fork_before']} -> {join['no_fork_after']}; with a V opening {join['v_opening_before']} -> "
2069             f"{join['v_opening_after']}")
2070    # Score, print and save like any run, compared tree by tree with the run it came from.
2071    masks_summary, _, pixel = _pixel_columns(src, trees, joined, None)
2072    header = ["tree", "row", "fold", "fork_found", "fork_found_before", "pieces_joined", "pixels_added",
2073              *(f"{c}_before_joining" for c in MASK_COLUMNS)]
2074    rows = [[t, info[t]["row"], info[t]["fold"], int(after[i]), int(before[i]), int(pieces[i]), int(added[i]),
2075             *pixel[t]] for i, t in enumerate(trees)]
2076    moved = [t for i, t in enumerate(trees) if pieces[i]]
2077    failed = _rescored_run(src, source, info, trees, joined, seg, out,
2078                           {"masks": masks_summary, "masks_note": "pixel scores of the masks before joining",
2079                            "join": join},
2080                           header, rows, figures, ("masks", {t: masks[t] for t in moved}, {t: joined[t] for t in moved}),
2081                           ((src.name, "segmentation"),), progress)
2082    return out, failed

Score a saved run's masks again after joining their pieces (join_pieces()).

Everything comes from the run's own files, so no photos are needed: predicted_masks.npz, and predictions.csv for each tree's row, fold, winter and hand-mask measures and its fold's mean shape. The result is a run like any other (report.json, predictions.csv, mask_scores.csv, predicted_masks.npz), in <run>_joined (or <run>_joined_<gap> for another gap), compared tree by tree with the run it came from and the other saved runs. Its pixel scores are the run's own, of the masks before joining (the hand masks are not needed here); mask_scores.csv lists the pieces joined and pixels added per tree.

Arguments:
  • src: The saved run's folder.
  • gap: Largest gap joined (JOIN_GAP, fixed from geometry).
  • out: Results folder (default: beside src, as above).
  • figures: Where the skill figure and the joins' contact sheet go (None: no figures).
  • progress: Where the printed summary goes.
Returns:

(out, paths that could not be written).

def grown_run( src: pathlib._local.Path, low: float, choice: dict | None = None, hands: dict[str, numpy.ndarray] | None = None, gap: float = 19.3, out: pathlib._local.Path | None = None, figures: pathlib._local.Path | None = None, progress: Callable[[str], None] = <built-in function print>) -> tuple[pathlib._local.Path, list[str]]: 
2085def grown_run(src: Path, low: float, choice: dict | None = None, hands: dict[str, np.ndarray] | None = None,
2086              gap: float = JOIN_GAP, out: Path | None = None, figures: Path | None = None,
2087              progress: Callable[[str], None] = print) -> tuple[Path, list[str]]:
2088    """Score a saved run's masks again after growing them (:func:`grow_mask`) and joining their pieces.
2089
2090    Like :func:`joined_run`, from the run's own files, plus its
2091    ``probabilities.npz``: each saved mask is grown into the pixels above
2092    ``low`` connected to it, then joined (:func:`join_pieces`), then measured.
2093    The result goes to ``<run>_grown`` and is compared tree by tree with
2094    ``<run>_joined`` (the same network, joined only) and the other saved runs.
2095
2096    Args:
2097        src: The saved run's folder (with ``probabilities.npz``).
2098        low: The lower threshold (chosen by :func:`choose_low`, never on winter).
2099        choice: How ``low`` was chosen (``{str(low): mean clDice}``), for the report.
2100        hands: ``{tree: hand mask}`` for pixel scores of the grown masks (else the run's own, before growing).
2101        gap: The joining gap after growing.
2102        out: Results folder (default ``<run>_grown``).
2103        figures: Where the skill figure and the contact sheet of the most grown masks go (None: none).
2104        progress: Where the printed summary goes.
2105
2106    Returns:
2107        ``(out, paths that could not be written)``.
2108    """
2109    src = Path(src)
2110    source, info = _read_run(src)
2111    masks = load_masks(src / "predicted_masks.npz")
2112    probs = load_probabilities(src / "probabilities.npz")
2113    trees = [t for t in info if t in masks and t in probs]
2114    out = Path(out) if out else src.parent / f"{src.name}_grown"
2115    high = float(source.get("params", {}).get("threshold", 0.5))
2116    # Grow each mask into its connected pixels above ``low`` (hysteresis), then join its pieces.
2117    final, grown_px, pieces = {}, np.zeros(len(trees), int), np.zeros(len(trees), int)
2118    for i, t in enumerate(trees):
2119        grown = grow_mask(probs[t], low, masks[t], high)
2120        grown_px[i] = int((grown & ~masks[t]).sum())
2121        final[t], pieces[i] = join_pieces(grown, gap)
2122    # The comparison is the same masks joined but not grown, so only the growing differs.
2123    seg = _measure_all(final, trees)
2124    joined_only = {t: join_pieces(masks[t], gap)[0] for t in trees}
2125    seg0 = _measure_all(joined_only, trees)
2126    v = MEASURES.index("v_opening")
2127    before, after = np.isfinite(seg0).any(axis=1), np.isfinite(seg).any(axis=1)
2128    change = np.abs(seg - seg0)                             # a measure gained or lost counts as changed
2129    change[np.isnan(seg) != np.isnan(seg0)] = np.inf
2130    moved = np.nan_to_num(change, nan=0.0).max(axis=1)
2131    grow = {"source": str(src), "low": low, "high": high, "chosen_by": "mean clDice against the lined-up hand masks",
2132            "cldice": choice or {}, "masks_grown": int((grown_px > 0).sum()), "pixels_added": int(grown_px.sum()),
2133            "no_fork_joined_only": int((~before).sum()), "no_fork_grown": int((~after).sum()),
2134            "v_opening_joined_only": int(np.isfinite(seg0[:, v]).sum()),
2135            "v_opening_grown": int(np.isfinite(seg[:, v]).sum()),
2136            "masks_whose_measures_changed": int((moved > 0.5).sum())}
2137    progress(f"Grown into pixels above {low:g} connected to each mask: {_n(grow['masks_grown'], 'mask')} of "
2138             f"{len(trees)} grew ({grow['pixels_added']} pixels); then joined within {gap:g} px. Masks with no fork "
2139             f"(joined only -> grown) {grow['no_fork_joined_only']} -> {grow['no_fork_grown']}; with a V opening "
2140             f"{grow['v_opening_joined_only']} -> {grow['v_opening_grown']}; measures moved by more than 0.5 degrees "
2141             f"in {grow['masks_whose_measures_changed']}")
2142    masks_summary, note, pixel = _pixel_columns(src, trees, final, hands)
2143    header = ["tree", "row", "fold", "fork_found", "fork_found_joined_only", "pixels_grown", "pieces_joined",
2144              "largest_change_deg", *(MASK_COLUMNS if hands is not None else
2145                                      tuple(f"{c}_before_growing" for c in MASK_COLUMNS))]
2146    rows = [[t, info[t]["row"], info[t]["fold"], int(after[i]), int(before[i]), int(grown_px[i]), int(pieces[i]),
2147             f"{moved[i]:.2f}", *pixel[t]] for i, t in enumerate(trees)]
2148    top = [trees[i] for i in np.argsort(-moved)[:48] if moved[i] > 0.5]
2149    failed = _rescored_run(src, source, info, trees, final, seg, out,
2150                           {"masks": masks_summary, "masks_note": note, "grow": grow, "join": {"gap": gap}},
2151                           header, rows, figures, ("masks", {t: masks[t] for t in top}, {t: final[t] for t in top}),
2152                           ((src.name, "segmentation"), (f"{src.name}_joined", "segmentation")), progress)
2153    return out, failed

Score a saved run's masks again after growing them (grow_mask()) and joining their pieces.

Like joined_run(), from the run's own files, plus its probabilities.npz: each saved mask is grown into the pixels above low connected to it, then joined (join_pieces()), then measured. The result goes to <run>_grown and is compared tree by tree with <run>_joined (the same network, joined only) and the other saved runs.

Arguments:
  • src: The saved run's folder (with probabilities.npz).
  • low: The lower threshold (chosen by choose_low(), never on winter).
  • choice: How low was chosen ({str(low): mean clDice}), for the report.
  • hands: {tree: hand mask} for pixel scores of the grown masks (else the run's own, before growing).
  • gap: The joining gap after growing.
  • out: Results folder (default <run>_grown).
  • figures: Where the skill figure and the contact sheet of the most grown masks go (None: none).
  • progress: Where the printed summary goes.
Returns:

(out, paths that could not be written).

def continued_run( src: pathlib._local.Path, cone: float = 25.0, out: pathlib._local.Path | None = None, figures: pathlib._local.Path | None = None, progress: Callable[[str], None] = <built-in function print>) -> tuple[pathlib._local.Path, list[str]]: 
2156def continued_run(src: Path, cone: float = CONTINUE_CONE, out: Path | None = None, figures: Path | None = None,
2157                  progress: Callable[[str], None] = print) -> tuple[Path, list[str]]:
2158    """Score a saved joined run's masks again after continuing short leaders and pruning (:func:`continue_leaders`).
2159
2160    Like :func:`joined_run`, from the run's own files (no photos). ``src`` is a
2161    joined run (e.g. ``segment_lined_up_rerun_joined``); the result goes to
2162    ``<run>_continued`` beside it (``_joined`` dropped from the name) and is
2163    compared tree by tree with ``src`` and the other saved runs. Pixel scores
2164    are the run's own, of the masks before the change.
2165
2166    Args:
2167        src: A saved joined run's folder.
2168        cone: Largest angle (degrees) between a short leader's direction at its tip and a piece it is
2169            continued to.
2170        out: The results folder; ``<run>_continued`` beside ``src`` by default.
2171        figures: The folder for the figures; the run's default by default.
2172        progress: Prints a progress line.
2173
2174    Returns:
2175        ``(out, paths that could not be written)``.
2176    """
2177    src = Path(src)
2178    source, info = _read_run(src)
2179    masks = load_masks(src / "predicted_masks.npz")
2180    trees = [t for t in info if t in masks]
2181    out = Path(out) if out else src.parent / f"{src.name.removesuffix('_joined')}_continued"
2182    final, pieces = {}, np.zeros(len(trees), int)
2183    for i, t in enumerate(trees):
2184        final[t], pieces[i] = continue_leaders(masks[t], cone)
2185    seg, seg0 = _measure_all(final, trees), _measure_all(masks, trees)
2186    v = MEASURES.index("v_opening")
2187    change = np.abs(seg - seg0)
2188    change[np.isnan(seg) != np.isnan(seg0)] = np.inf
2189    moved = np.nan_to_num(change, nan=0.0).max(axis=1)
2190    removed = np.array([int((masks[t] & ~final[t]).sum()) for t in trees])
2191    cont = {"source": str(src), "cone": cone, "masks_continued": int((pieces > 0).sum()),
2192            "pieces_joined": int(pieces.sum()), "pixels_pruned": int(removed.sum()),
2193            "v_opening_before": int(np.isfinite(seg0[:, v]).sum()), "v_opening_after": int(np.isfinite(seg[:, v]).sum()),
2194            "masks_whose_measures_changed": int((moved > 0.5).sum())}
2195    progress(f"Short leaders continued to pieces on their line (within {cone:g} degrees and the missing stretch) in "
2196             f"{_n(cont['masks_continued'], 'mask')} of {len(trees)} ({_n(cont['pieces_joined'], 'piece')}); every mask "
2197             f"cut down to its trunk and two leaders ({cont['pixels_pruned']} pixels removed). With a V opening "
2198             f"{cont['v_opening_before']} -> {cont['v_opening_after']}; measures moved by more than 0.5 degrees in "
2199             f"{cont['masks_whose_measures_changed']}")
2200    masks_summary, _, pixel = _pixel_columns(src, trees, final, None)
2201    header = ["tree", "row", "fold", "fork_found", "pieces_joined", "pixels_pruned", "largest_change_deg",
2202              *(f"{c}_before" for c in MASK_COLUMNS)]
2203    rows = [[t, info[t]["row"], info[t]["fold"], int(np.isfinite(seg[i]).any()), int(pieces[i]), int(removed[i]),
2204             f"{moved[i]:.2f}", *pixel[t]] for i, t in enumerate(trees)]
2205    shown = [t for i, t in enumerate(trees) if pieces[i]] or [trees[i] for i in np.argsort(-moved)[:24]]
2206    failed = _rescored_run(src, source, info, trees, final, seg, out,
2207                           {"masks": masks_summary, "masks_note": "pixel scores of the masks before continuing and pruning",
2208                            "continue": cont, "join": source.get("join", {})},
2209                           header, rows, figures, ("masks", {t: masks[t] for t in shown}, {t: final[t] for t in shown}),
2210                           ((src.name, "segmentation"),), progress)
2211    return out, failed

Score a saved joined run's masks again after continuing short leaders and pruning (continue_leaders()).

Like joined_run(), from the run's own files (no photos). src is a joined run (e.g. segment_lined_up_rerun_joined); the result goes to <run>_continued beside it (_joined dropped from the name) and is compared tree by tree with src and the other saved runs. Pixel scores are the run's own, of the masks before the change.

Arguments:
  • src: A saved joined run's folder.
  • cone: Largest angle (degrees) between a short leader's direction at its tip and a piece it is continued to.
  • out: The results folder; <run>_continued beside src by default.
  • figures: The folder for the figures; the run's default by default.
  • progress: Prints a progress line.
Returns:

(out, paths that could not be written).

def completed_run( src: pathlib._local.Path, out: pathlib._local.Path | None = None, figures: pathlib._local.Path | None = None, progress: Callable[[str], None] = <built-in function print>) -> tuple[pathlib._local.Path, list[str]]: 
2214def completed_run(src: Path, out: Path | None = None, figures: Path | None = None,
2215                  progress: Callable[[str], None] = print) -> tuple[Path, list[str]]:
2216    """Score a saved joined run again with its short leaders' lines predicted over the whole stretch.
2217
2218    The model (:func:`fit_completion`) is fitted on the run's own complete
2219    leaders cut short on purpose (:func:`completion_samples`), for each fold
2220    on the other folds' trees only, so no tree's prediction uses its own
2221    leaders; the fit on all trees is kept for the final test. The masks are
2222    not changed. The result goes to ``<run>_completed`` (``_joined`` dropped)
2223    and is compared tree by tree with ``src`` and the other saved runs.
2224
2225    Args:
2226        src: A saved joined run's folder.
2227        out: The results folder; ``<run>_completed`` beside ``src`` by default.
2228        figures: The folder for the figures; the run's default by default.
2229        progress: Prints a progress line.
2230
2231    Returns:
2232        ``(out, paths that could not be written)``.
2233    """
2234    src = Path(src)
2235    source, info = _read_run(src)
2236    masks = load_masks(src / "predicted_masks.npz")
2237    trees = [t for t in info if t in masks]
2238    out = Path(out) if out else src.parent / f"{src.name.removesuffix('_joined')}_completed"
2239    folds = sorted({info[t]["fold"] for t in trees})
2240    samples = {f: completion_samples({t: masks[t] for t in trees if info[t]["fold"] != f}) for f in folds}
2241    coef = {f: fit_completion(samples[f]) for f in folds}
2242    coef_all = fit_completion(completion_samples({t: masks[t] for t in trees}))
2243    seg = np.full((len(trees), len(MEASURES)), np.nan)
2244    done = np.zeros(len(trees), int)
2245    for i, t in enumerate(trees):
2246        m, done[i] = complete_measures(masks[t], coef[info[t]["fold"]])
2247        seg[i] = [m[k] for k in MEASURES]
2248    comp = {"source": str(src), "model": "whole - cut = a*g + c*g*bend (outward line from the vertical)",
2249            "fractions": list(COMPLETE_FRACTIONS), "coef_all": [float(v) for v in coef_all],
2250            "coef_by_fold": {str(f): [float(v) for v in c] for f, c in coef.items()},
2251            "leaders_completed": int(done.sum()), "trees_completed": int((done > 0).sum())}
2252    progress(f"Short leaders' lines predicted over the whole stretch in {_n(comp['trees_completed'], 'tree')} "
2253             f"({_n(comp['leaders_completed'], 'leader')}); model fitted per fold on the other folds' complete leaders "
2254             f"(all trees: a = {coef_all[0]:+.2f}, c = {coef_all[1]:+.3f})")
2255    masks_summary, _, pixel = _pixel_columns(src, trees, masks, None)
2256    header = ["tree", "row", "fold", "fork_found", "leaders_completed", *MASK_COLUMNS]
2257    rows = [[t, info[t]["row"], info[t]["fold"], int(np.isfinite(seg[i]).any()), int(done[i]), *pixel[t]]
2258            for i, t in enumerate(trees)]
2259    failed = _rescored_run(src, source, info, trees, masks, seg, out,
2260                           {"masks": masks_summary, "masks_note": "the masks are not changed", "complete": comp,
2261                            "join": source.get("join", {})},
2262                           header, rows, figures, None, ((src.name, "segmentation"),), progress)
2263    return out, failed

Score a saved joined run again with its short leaders' lines predicted over the whole stretch.

The model (fit_completion()) is fitted on the run's own complete leaders cut short on purpose (completion_samples()), for each fold on the other folds' trees only, so no tree's prediction uses its own leaders; the fit on all trees is kept for the final test. The masks are not changed. The result goes to <run>_completed (_joined dropped) and is compared tree by tree with src and the other saved runs.

Arguments:
  • src: A saved joined run's folder.
  • out: The results folder; <run>_completed beside src by default.
  • figures: The folder for the figures; the run's default by default.

def draw_joins( before: dict[str, numpy.ndarray], after: dict[str, numpy.ndarray], columns: int = 8, scale: float = 0.5): 
2266def draw_joins(before: dict[str, np.ndarray], after: dict[str, np.ndarray], columns: int = 8, scale: float = 0.5):
2267    """A contact sheet of joined masks: each tile the mask (grey), the pixels the join added (magenta) and the
2268    centre lines and fitted lines found after joining; masks whose V opening could be measured only after
2269    joining come first, labelled. A PIL image; needs no photos.
2270
2271    Args:
2272        before: Masks per tree id before joining (every one is drawn).
2273        after: The same trees' masks after joining.
2274        columns: Tiles per row.
2275        scale: Tile size relative to the masks' frame.
2276
2277    Returns:
2278        The contact sheet (PIL image).
2279    """
2280    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
2281
2282    from treeskel.shape import draw_shape, fitted_lines
2283
2284    params = ShapeParams()
2285    order = sorted(before, key=lambda t: (np.isfinite(mask_shape(before[t])[0]["v_opening"]), t))
2286    size = round(256 * scale)
2287    rows = math.ceil(len(order) / columns)
2288    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (columns * size, rows * size), (20, 20, 20))
2289    font = ImageFont.load_default(size=11)
2290    for i, t in enumerate(order):
2291        b, a = np.asarray(before[t], bool), np.asarray(after[t], bool)
2292        rgb = np.full(b.shape + (3,), 20, np.uint8)
2293        rgb[b] = (150, 150, 150)
2294        rgb[a & ~b] = (235, 80, 235)
2295        br = mask_branches(a)
2296        if br is None:
2297            im = draw_shape(rgb, (), {})
2298        else:
2299            lines = fitted_lines(br["trunk"], br["left"], br["right"], br["fork_radius"], params, MASK_ZOOM)
2300            im = draw_shape(rgb, [br[p] for p in ("trunk", "left", "right")], lines)
2301        tile = im.resize((size, size), Image.BILINEAR)
2302        found = not np.isfinite(mask_shape(b)[0]["v_opening"]) and np.isfinite(mask_shape(a)[0]["v_opening"])
2303        ImageDraw.Draw(tile).text((4, 3), t + ("  V measured" if found else ""), fill=(255, 255, 0), font=font,
2304                                  stroke_width=1, stroke_fill=(0, 0, 0))
2305        sheet.paste(tile, ((i % columns) * size, (i // columns) * size))
2306    return sheet

  • before: Masks per tree id before joining (every one is drawn).
  • after: The same trees' masks after joining.

  • scale: Tile size relative to the masks' frame.

The contact sheet (PIL image).

def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int: 
2349def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
2350    """Train on the development rows' hand masks, fold by fold, and score the masks and their shape
2351    (or, with ``--replot``, only redraw the figures from a saved run).
2352
2353    Args:
2354        argv: Command-line arguments; ``None`` reads ``sys.argv[1:]``.
2355
2356    Returns:
2357        The exit status: 0 on success, 1 if the output folder already holds a run, the table holds test-row
2358        trees, too few trees or no lined-up masks were found, PyTorch is missing, the GPU ran out of memory,
2359        or an output file could not be written (each is reported).
2360    """
2361    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m treeskel.segment", description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
2362    ap.add_argument("data_dirs", nargs="*", help="dataset folder(s) with the summer photos and hand masks")
2363    ap.add_argument("--table", default="data/shape/shape_measures.csv", help="winter measures (treeskel.shape)")
2364    ap.add_argument("--traces", default="data/shape/winter_traces.npz", help="winter traces, for the example figure")
2365    ap.add_argument("--split", default="splits.json")
2366    ap.add_argument("--out", help="results folder (default: docs/results/<the run's name>)")
2367    ap.add_argument("--figures", default="docs/figures", help="folder for the figures")
2368    ap.add_argument("--device", help="cuda or cpu (default: the GPU if there is one)")
2369    ap.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=SegParams.epochs, help="most epochs tried")
2370    ap.add_argument("--size", type=int, nargs="+", default=[SegParams.size], metavar="N",
2371                    help="one number: side of the square input, the masks' frame (default 256); two, H W: the "
2372                         "whole photo at that size, e.g. 480 640 (each divisible by 32)")
2373    ap.add_argument("--encoder", default=SegParams.encoder, choices=("resnet18", "resnet34"))
2374    ap.add_argument("--depth", action="store_true", help="also give the network the summer depth")
2375    ap.add_argument("--mask-overlay", metavar="JSON",
2376                    help="train on the hand masks lined up with treeskel.annotate_mask (e.g. "
2377                         "annotations/mask_overlay.json); only lined-up trees train")
2378    ap.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=SegParams.batch,
2379                    help="photos per training step (smaller if the GPU runs out of memory; recorded in the report)")
2380    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=SegParams.seed,
2381                    help="random seed; another seed is another sample of the recipe (named _seed<n>)")
2382    ap.add_argument("--cldice", nargs="?", type=float, const=CLDICE_WEIGHT, default=0.0, metavar="ALPHA",
2383                    help=f"add the soft centre-line Dice to the loss, at weight ALPHA (default {CLDICE_WEIGHT:g}): "
2384                         "BCE + (1 - ALPHA) Dice + ALPHA clDice")
2385    ap.add_argument("--no-grow", action="store_true",
2386                    help="skip scoring the grown masks after training (session 12's idea, not adopted)")
2387    ap.add_argument("--examples", type=int, default=6, help="trees in the example figure")
2388    ap.add_argument("--replot", metavar="DIR", help="only redraw the figures from this results folder")
2389    ap.add_argument("--join", metavar="DIR",
2390                    help="only score a saved run's masks again with their pieces joined (writes DIR_joined)")
2391    ap.add_argument("--join-gap", type=float, default=JOIN_GAP,
2392                    help=f"largest gap joined, mask px (default {JOIN_GAP:g}: about a trunk's width, fixed)")
2393    ap.add_argument("--grow", metavar="DIR",
2394                    help="only score a saved run's masks again, grown into the less sure pixels connected to them "
2395                         "and joined (writes DIR_grown); the lower threshold is --grow-low, or chosen on the hand "
2396                         "masks if the dataset folder(s) are given")
2397    ap.add_argument("--grow-low", type=float, help="the lower threshold for --grow (default: chosen by clDice)")
2398    ap.add_argument("--complete", metavar="DIR",
2399                    help="only score a saved joined run again with its short leaders' lines predicted over the "
2400                         "whole stretch from complete leaders' shapes (writes <run>_completed)")
2401    ap.add_argument("--continue", dest="continue_run", metavar="DIR",
2402                    help="only score a saved joined run's masks again with short leaders continued to pieces on their "
2403                         "line, and cut down to the trunk and two leaders (writes <run>_continued)")
2404    ap.add_argument("--overwrite", action="store_true", help="train even if the results folder holds a run")
2405    ap.add_argument("--random-weights", action="store_true", help="skip the ImageNet weights (tests only)")
2406    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
2407
2408    if args.replot:
2409        failed = replot(Path(args.replot), Path(args.figures))
2410        print(f"Saved the figures in {args.figures}")
2411        for f in failed:
2412            print(f"Could not write {f}")
2413        return 1 if failed else 0
2414    if args.join:
2415        out, failed = joined_run(Path(args.join), args.join_gap, Path(args.out) if args.out else None,
2416                                 Path(args.figures))
2417        for f in failed:
2418            print(f"Could not write {f}")
2419        return 1 if failed else 0
2420    if args.grow:
2421        return _grow_command(args)
2422    if args.complete:
2423        out, failed = completed_run(Path(args.complete), out=Path(args.out) if args.out else None,
2424                                    figures=Path(args.figures))
2425        for f in failed:
2426            print(f"Could not write {f}")
2427        return 1 if failed else 0
2428    if args.continue_run:
2429        out, failed = continued_run(Path(args.continue_run), out=Path(args.out) if args.out else None,
2430                                    figures=Path(args.figures))
2431        for f in failed:
2432            print(f"Could not write {f}")
2433        return 1 if failed else 0
2434    if not args.data_dirs:
2435        ap.error("give the dataset folder(s), or --replot, --join, --grow, --continue or --complete")
2436    if len(args.size) > 2 or any(v % 32 for v in args.size):
2437        ap.error(f"--size takes one or two numbers, each divisible by 32; got {args.size}")
2438    size = args.size[0] if len(args.size) == 1 else (args.size[0], args.size[1])
2439
2440    from treeskel.io import index_dataset
2441
2442    if not 0 <= args.cldice <= 1:
2443        ap.error(f"--cldice takes a weight between 0 and 1; got {args.cldice:g}")
2444    params = SegParams(size=size, encoder=args.encoder, epochs=args.epochs, batch=args.batch, seed=args.seed,
2445                       depth=args.depth, cldice=args.cldice)
2446    out = Path(args.out or f"docs/results/{variant(params, args.mask_overlay is not None)}")
2447    if (out / "report.json").exists() and not args.overwrite:
2448        print(f"{out} already holds a run. Give another --out (e.g. {out}_2), or --overwrite to replace it.")
2449        return 1
2450    split = json.loads(Path(args.split).read_text())
2451    test_rows = set(split["test_rows"])
2452    table = load_table(args.table)
2453    if any(r["row"] in test_rows for r in table):
2454        print("The table holds test-row trees; they are never used here. Stopping.")
2455        return 1
2456    records = {t.tree_id: t for d in args.data_dirs for t in index_dataset(d).trees}
2457    by_id = {r["tree"]: r for r in table}
2458    trees = sorted(t for t in by_id if t in records and records[t].row not in test_rows)
2459    if len(trees) < 3:
2460        print(f"Only {len(trees)} trees have both measures and photos; nothing to train.")
2461        return 1
2462    try:
2463        import torch  # noqa: F401
2464        import torchvision  # noqa: F401
2465    except ImportError as e:
2466        print(f"PyTorch and torchvision are needed: {e}")
2467        return 1
2468    what = "photos, depth and hand masks" if params.depth else "photos and hand masks"
2469    frame = "whole photos" if whole_photo(params) else "masks' frame"
2470    print(f"{len(trees)} development trees; loading the summer {what} ({frame}) at "
2471          f"{input_shape(params)[0]}x{input_shape(params)[1]}...", flush=True)
2472    overlays = None
2473    if args.mask_overlay:
2474        from treeskel.summer_gt import load_overlays
2475
2476        overlays = load_overlays(args.mask_overlay)
2477        if not overlays:
2478            print(f"No lined-up masks in {args.mask_overlay}. Stopping.")
2479            return 1
2480    images, masks, has = load_frames(records, trees, params.size, params.depth, lambda m: print(m, flush=True),
2481                                     overlays)
2482    print(f"{int(has.sum())} of them have a hand mask to train on"
2483          + (f" (lined up; {sum(1 for t in trees if t in overlays and overlays[t].skip)} skipped, "
2484             f"{sum(1 for t in trees if records[t].has_mask and t not in overlays)} not lined up yet)"
2485             if overlays is not None else ""), flush=True)
2486    rows = np.array([by_id[t]["row"] for t in trees])
2487    t0 = time.time()
2488    try:
2489        cv = cross_validate_seg(images, masks, has, rows, split["fold_val_rows"], params, args.device,
2490                                pretrained=not args.random_weights, progress=lambda m: print(m, flush=True))
2491    except (OSError, RuntimeError) as e:                   # a failed weights download, or out of GPU memory
2492        print(f"Training stopped: {type(e).__name__}: {e}\nIf the GPU ran out of memory, close other programs "
2493              "using it (nvidia-smi lists them) and try again, or add --batch 4.")
2494        return 1
2495    minutes = round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1)
2496
2497    # Score every predicted tree: its mask against the hand mask, its shape against the winter trace.
2498    from treeskel.io import MASK_SHAPE
2499
2500    done = cv["fold"] >= 0
2501    pred_masks = np.zeros((len(trees),) + MASK_SHAPE, bool)
2502    probs = np.zeros((len(trees),) + MASK_SHAPE, np.float32)          # in the masks' frame, for growing
2503    seg = np.full((len(trees), len(MEASURES)), np.nan)
2504    scores = {t: dict.fromkeys(MASK_COLUMNS, float("nan")) for t in trees}
2505    for i, t in enumerate(trees):
2506        if not done[i]:
2507            continue
2508        probs[i] = prob_frame(cv["prob"][i], whole_photo(params))
2509        pred_masks[i] = probs[i] > params.threshold                  # as to_mask_size
2510        m, _ = mask_shape(pred_masks[i])
2511        seg[i] = [m[k] for k in MEASURES]
2512        if has[i]:
2513            scores[t] = mask_scores(pred_masks[i], hand_mask(records[t], overlays))   # the mask it was trained on
2514    y = np.array([[by_id[t][f"winter_{k}"] for k in MEASURES] for t in trees], float)
2515    hand = np.array([[by_id[t][f"hand_{k}"] for k in MEASURES] for t in trees], float)
2516    mean = np.full_like(y, np.nan)
2517    for f in sorted(set(cv["fold"][done].tolist())):
2518        va = cv["fold"] == f
2519        with warnings.catch_warnings():
2520            warnings.simplefilter("ignore", RuntimeWarning)
2521            mean[va] = np.nanmean(y[~va], axis=0)          # the fold's training rows' mean shape, as shape_cnn
2522    no_fork = int((done & ~np.isfinite(seg).any(axis=1)).sum())
2523    seg_filled = fill_failures(seg, mean)
2524
2525    report = {"n_trees": int(done.sum()), "n_masks": int((done & has).sum()),
2526              "variant": out.name, "recipe": variant(params, overlays is not None),   # its folder; its settings' name
2527              "mask_overlay": args.mask_overlay,
2528              "params": asdict(params), "device": cv["device"],
2529              "weights": "random" if args.random_weights else "IMAGENET1K_V1", "epochs": cv["epochs"],
2530              "minutes": minutes, "no_fork": no_fork, "masks": {}, "scores": {}, "against_runs": {}}
2531    for c in MASK_COLUMNS:
2532        v = np.array([scores[t][c] for t in trees])[done & has]
2533        v = v[np.isfinite(v)]
2534        report["masks"][c] = {"median": float(np.median(v)) if len(v) else None,
2535                              "mean": float(v.mean()) if len(v) else None, "n": int(len(v))}
2536    folds = cv["fold"]
2537    for j, k in enumerate(MEASURES):
2538        base = mean[:, j]
2539        mean_shape = evaluate(y[:, j], base, base, folds)
2540        mean_shape["r"] = None
2541        report["scores"][k] = {"mean shape": mean_shape, "hand masks": evaluate(y[:, j], hand[:, j], base, folds),
2542                               "segmentation": evaluate(y[:, j], seg_filled[:, j], base, folds),
2543                               "segmentation, forks found": evaluate(y[:, j], seg[:, j], base, folds)}
2544
2545    print(f"\nPredicted masks against the hand masks ({report['n_masks']} trees; median, mean):")
2546    for c in MASK_COLUMNS:
2547        s = report["masks"][c]
2548        if s["n"]:
2549            print(f"  {c:9s} {s['median']:.3f}  {s['mean']:.3f}")
2550    print(f"No fork found in {_n(no_fork, 'predicted mask')} (scored as the mean shape)")
2551    for title, names in (("Headline (no reference direction)", HEADLINE), ("From the trunk's axis", TRUNK_RELATIVE),
2552                         ("From the photo's vertical (camera roll adds to these)", VERTICAL)):
2553        print(f"\n{title}:")
2554        print_scores(report, names)
2555
2556    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2557    failed: list[str] = []
2558
2559    def write(path: Path, fn) -> None:
2560        """Write one output file; a file that cannot be written is listed, not fatal."""
2561        try:
2562            fn(path)
2563        except OSError as e:                                # e.g. open in a viewer on Windows
2564            failed.append(f"{path}: {e.strerror or e}")
2565
2566    def predictions(path):
2567        """Write every tree's measures: winter, the mean shape, the hand masks and the segmentation."""
2568        with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
2569            w = csv.writer(f)
2570            w.writerow(["tree", "row", "fold", "measure", "winter", "mean shape", "hand masks", "segmentation"])
2571            for i, t in enumerate(trees):
2572                if done[i]:
2573                    for j, k in enumerate(MEASURES):
2574                        w.writerow([t, int(rows[i]), int(folds[i]), k]
2575                                   + ["" if not np.isfinite(v) else f"{v:.2f}"
2576                                      for v in (y[i, j], mean[i, j], hand[i, j], seg_filled[i, j])])
2577
2578    def mask_table(path):
2579        """Write each mask's pixel scores against its hand mask."""
2580        with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
2581            w = csv.writer(f)
2582            w.writerow(["tree", "row", "fold", "fork_found", *MASK_COLUMNS])
2583            for i, t in enumerate(trees):
2584                if done[i]:
2585                    w.writerow([t, int(rows[i]), int(folds[i]), int(np.isfinite(seg[i]).any())]
2586                               + ["" if not np.isfinite(scores[t][c]) else f"{scores[t][c]:.4f}" for c in MASK_COLUMNS])
2587
2588    def training_log(path):
2589        """Write the training and validation loss of every epoch and fold."""
2590        with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
2591            w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["fold", "stage", "epoch", "train_loss", "val_loss"])
2592            w.writeheader()
2593            w.writerows(cv["log"])
2594
2595    write(out / "predictions.csv", predictions)
2596    write(out / "mask_scores.csv", mask_table)
2597    write(out / "training_log.csv", training_log)
2598    write(out / "predicted_masks.npz", lambda p: save_masks(p, [t for i, t in enumerate(trees) if done[i]],
2599                                                            pred_masks[done]))
2600    write(out / "probabilities.npz", lambda p: save_probabilities(p, [t for i, t in enumerate(trees) if done[i]],
2601                                                                  probs[done]))
2602    # Tree by tree against the other runs, on the same trees and folds.

2613        from PIL import Image

2615        from treeskel.shape import load_traces

2617        traces = load_traces(args.traces) if Path(args.traces).exists() else {}
2618        picks = example_trees({t: scores[t]["dice"] for i, t in enumerate(trees) if done[i]}, args.examples)
2619        tiles = []
2620        for t in picks:
2621            i = trees.index(t)

2623            tiles.append(draw_example(records[t], pred_masks[i], traces.get(t), label, overlays=overlays))
2624        if tiles:

2626            ytop = 0

2631    print(f"\nTrained in {minutes} min on {cv['device']}. Saved {out}/ (report.json, predictions.csv, "

2641    return 0

Train on the development rows' hand masks, fold by fold, and score the masks and their shape (or, with --replot, only redraw the figures from a saved run).

Arguments:
  • argv: Command-line arguments; None reads sys.argv[1:].
Returns:

The exit status: 0 on success, 1 if the output folder already holds a run, the table holds test-row trees, too few trees or no lined-up masks were found, PyTorch is missing, the GPU ran out of memory, or an output file could not be written (each is reported).
